function.name: getCityTime
function.description: Retrieve the current local time for a specified city, taking into account its time zone and daylight saving rules.

city.description: The name of the city for which to obtain the current local time.

format.description: Optional output format such as ISO8601, 24-hour, or 12-hour clock.

function.name: getHistoricalSolarRadiation
function.description: Provides historical solar radiation (insolation) measurements for a given city over a specified date range, allowing analysis of past sunlight exposure.

city.description: Name of the city for which solar radiation data is requested.

startDate.description: Start date of the period in YYYY‑MM‑DD format.

endDate.description: End date of the period in YYYY‑MM‑DD format.

unit.description: Optional unit for the radiation values, e.g., "kWh/m2" or "MJ/m2".

format.description: Optional output format, such as "json" or "csv".

function.name: getCityUVIndexForecast
function.description: Provides forecasted ultraviolet (UV) index values for the specified city over a date range.

city.description: Name of the city for which to forecast UV index

startDate.description: Start date of the forecast period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: End date of the forecast period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, a single-day forecast for startDate is returned.

format.description: Output format such as 'json' or 'text'

function.name: subscribeAQIThreshold
function.description: Register a notification that triggers when the Air Quality Index in a given city exceeds a specified threshold, sending the alert via the chosen contact method on the defined schedule.

city.description: City to monitor for AQI threshold breaches.

threshold.description: AQI value that, when crossed, will activate the alert.

contact.description: Contact information (email address or phone number) to receive the alert.

frequency.description: Frequency of checking the AQI and sending alerts.

function.name: getCityAQITrendReport
function.description: Generates a summary report of air quality index trends for a specified city over a given date range, including average, minimum, maximum values and day‑to‑day changes.

city.description: Name of the city for which the AQI trend report is requested.

startDate.description: Start date of the period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: End date of the period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

granularity.description: Level of aggregation for the report, e.g., "daily" or "weekly".

function.name: getCityPollutantBreakdown
function.description: Provides the percentage contribution of major pollutants (PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2, CO) to the AQI for a specific city on a given date.

city.description: Name of the city to query pollutant breakdown.

date.description: Date for which the pollutant breakdown is required, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

format.description: Desired output format, such as "json" or "csv".

function.name: getCityAQIAlert
function.description: Generates alerts when the forecasted Air Quality Index for a city exceeds a user‑defined threshold during a specified period, optionally specifying how the alert should be delivered.

city.description: Name of the city to monitor.

startDate.description: Start date (inclusive) of the monitoring window in YYYY‑MM‑DD format.

endDate.description: End date (inclusive) of the monitoring window in YYYY‑MM‑DD format.

threshold.description: AQI value above which an alert is triggered.

notificationMethod.description: Preferred method for receiving the alert, such as email or SMS.

function.name: getShowReviews
function.description: Retrieve aggregated audience reviews and ratings for a specific performance event identified by its unique ID.

showId.description: The unique identifier of the performance event

maxReviews.description: Maximum number of recent reviews to return (optional)

function.name: getEventMerchandise
function.description: List available merchandise items (e.g., t‑shirts, posters, programs) for a given performance event.

showId.description: The unique identifier of the performance event

currency.description: Currency code (e.g., USD, EUR) for price display (optional)

function.name: getShowTickets
function.description: Retrieve ticket availability, pricing tiers, and purchase options for a specific performance event.

show_id.description: The unique identifier of the performance event.

date.description: The date for which ticket information is requested, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

seat_category.description: Optional filter for a specific seat category or section (e.g., orchestra, balcony).

quantity.description: Number of tickets the user wishes to purchase.

function.name: getHealthInsuranceCoverage
function.description: Provides statistics on health insurance coverage across Swiss cantons, including the percentage of population covered by different types of health insurance for a given year.

year.description: Four‑digit year for which the coverage data is requested

canton.description: Name or abbreviation of the Swiss canton (optional)

insuranceType.description: Category of health insurance, such as basic or supplemental (optional)

function.name: getHousingPriceIndex
function.description: Retrieves the historical housing price index for Switzerland, allowing users to compare price trends across regions and property types for a specific year.

year.description: Four‑digit year for which the price index is needed

region.description: Geographic region, canton, or city (optional)

propertyType.description: Type of property, e.g., apartment or single‑family house (optional)

function.name: getSchoolFundingInfo
function.description: Provides detailed financial information for a specified school or university in Switzerland, including annual budget, funding sources, and expenditure breakdowns.

institutionId.description: Unique identifier or name of the school or university

fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year for which funding data is requested, e.g., "2023"

currency.description: Currency code for monetary values, e.g., "CHF" (optional)

function.name: getCampusFacilityDetails
function.description: Retrieves information about specific campus facilities of a Swiss educational institution, such as libraries, laboratories, sports centers, and their accessibility features.

institutionId.description: Unique identifier or name of the school or university

includeAccessibility.description: Whether to include details on accessibility accommodations (optional)

function.name: getMeteorologicalStationInfo
function.description: Retrieve metadata about meteorological observation stations in Switzerland, including coordinates, elevation, and available sensors.

location.description: Name of a city, region, or coordinates to find nearby stations

stationId.description: Unique identifier of a specific station

includeSensors.description: Whether to include detailed sensor information

function.name: getLegislationProgress
function.description: Retrieve the current stage, history, and expected timeline of a specific Swiss federal bill or law, including its identifier, title, and any associated documents.

billId.description: The unique identifier or reference number of the bill or law in the Swiss parliament.

language.description: Preferred language for the returned information, e.g., 'en' or 'de'.

function.name: getParliamentMemberDetails
function.description: Obtain biographical data, party affiliation, constituency, and optional contact information for a member of the Swiss Federal Assembly.

memberId.description: The unique identifier of the parliament member.

includeContact.description: If true, include phone number and email address where available.

function.name: generateBudgetReport
function.description: Creates a detailed budget report for a user, summarizing account balances, category allocations, and transaction totals over a specified period, and returns the report in PDF or CSV format.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose budget report is to be generated.

start_date.description: The start date (inclusive) of the reporting period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date (inclusive) of the reporting period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

format.description: Desired output format for the report.

function.name: setBudgetGoal
function.description: Defines a financial goal for a specific budget category, specifying target amount and deadline to help users plan savings or spending limits.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user setting the goal.

category_name.description: Name of the budget category for which the goal is set.

target_amount.description: Desired amount to reach for the category (in the user's currency).

deadline.description: Date by which the target amount should be achieved, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: generateSpendingReport
function.description: Generates a summarized spending report for a user over a given date range, optionally filtered by specific categories.

startDate.description: The start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the reporting period.

endDate.description: The end date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the reporting period.

categoryList.description: An optional list of category names to include in the report. If omitted, all categories are included.

function.name: exportTransactions
function.description: Export a user's transactions from YNAB within a specified date range into a chosen file format such as CSV or JSON.

user_id.description: The identifier of the YNAB user whose transactions are to be exported.

start_date.description: The start date (inclusive) for the export period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date (inclusive) for the export period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

format.description: The file format for the export, e.g., 'csv' or 'json'.

function.name: generateSpendingInsights
function.description: Analyze a user's transaction history to produce insights about spending habits, top categories, and trends over a selected period.

user_id.description: The identifier of the YNAB user to analyze.

period.description: The time period for analysis, expressed as 'YYYY-MM' or a range like '2023-01 to 2023-06'.

include_subcategories.description: Whether to break down spending by sub‑categories.

function.name: deleteTransaction
function.description: Permanently removes a specified transaction from the user's YNAB account after optional confirmation, updating the budget balances accordingly.

transaction_id.description: The unique identifier of the transaction to be deleted.

account_id.description: The identifier of the account that contains the transaction.

confirm.description: Set to true to require explicit confirmation before deletion.

function.name: exportTransactionsReport
function.description: Generates a transaction report for a given account and date range in the chosen file format, optionally emailing the report to the user.

account_id.description: Identifier of the account to export transactions from.

start_date.description: The beginning date (inclusive) for the export period, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: The ending date (inclusive) for the export period, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

format.description: Desired file format for the exported report.

email.description: Email address to which the generated report will be sent.

function.name: fetchIpAsnInfo
function.description: Retrieves the Autonomous System Number (ASN) and related network information for an IP address, including the ISP name, organization, and IP prefix range.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address whose ASN information is requested.

includePrefixDetails.description: If true, include the IP prefix (CIDR) and allocation date in the response.

function.name: getIPThreatScore
function.description: Provides a risk assessment score for an IP address based on known malicious activity, blacklists, and threat intelligence feeds.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to evaluate.

source.description: Optional identifier of a specific threat intelligence source to query.

function.name: getAsnByIp
function.description: Retrieve the Autonomous System Number (ASN) and related ISP information for a given IP address, including the organization name and network range.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to lookup.

includePrefix.description: If true, include the network prefix length in the response.

function.name: biometricEnrollment
function.description: Enrolls a user's biometric profile by capturing a sample and associating it with the user's account for future passwordless authentication.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user whose biometric data is being enrolled.

biometricSample.description: Raw or encoded biometric sample (e.g., fingerprint image, facial scan) to be stored.

deviceSerial.description: Serial number of the device used to capture the biometric sample.

function.name: biometricAccessAudit
function.description: Retrieves and summarizes audit logs of biometric authentication attempts, allowing administrators to review successful and failed logins over a time range.

startTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking the beginning of the audit period.

endTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking the end of the audit period.

deviceId.description: Identifier of the device whose biometric logs should be filtered (optional).

function.name: emailDomainValidator
function.description: Validates whether a provided email address belongs to one of the allowed corporate or partner domains, returning a boolean result and optional reason for rejection.

email.description: The email address to be validated.

allowedDomains.description: List of domain strings (e.g., "example.com") that are permitted.

function.name: emailTemplateRenderer
function.description: Renders an email body by populating a stored template with supplied placeholder values, returning the final formatted message ready for sending.

templateId.description: Identifier of the email template to use.

placeholders.description: Key‑value pairs where each key corresponds to a placeholder in the template and the value is the text to substitute.

function.name: securityQuestionManager
function.description: Create, update, or delete security questions and answers for a user account to enable account recovery and additional verification steps.

userID.description: The unique identifier of the user account.

question.description: The security question to be set for the user.

answer.description: The answer corresponding to the security question.

function.name: trustedDeviceRegistry
function.description: Register or deregister a device as a trusted authentication device for a user, allowing or disallowing passwordless logins from that device.

userID.description: The unique identifier of the user account.

deviceID.description: The identifier of the device to be registered or deregistered.

operation.description: Action to perform: either "register" to add the device as trusted or "deregister" to remove it.

function.name: loginScreenLocalization
function.description: Configure the language, date format, and regional elements of the login interface for a given application.

appID.description: Identifier of the application whose login screen will be localized.

locale.description: Locale code (e.g., en-US, zh-CN) specifying the language and regional settings.

currencyFormat.description: Optional format for displaying currency on the login screen.

function.name: loginScreenCaptchaIntegration
function.description: Add a CAPTCHA challenge to the login page to mitigate automated login attempts.

appID.description: Identifier of the application where the CAPTCHA will be integrated.

captchaProvider.description: Name of the CAPTCHA service provider (e.g., reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha).

siteKey.description: Public site key issued by the CAPTCHA provider.

thresholdScore.description: Optional risk score threshold for allowing login without additional verification.

function.name: sessionAnomalyDetector
function.description: Analyzes user session logs to identify sessions that deviate from normal behavior patterns, flagging potential security incidents or misuse based on configurable thresholds and time windows.

appID.description: Identifier of the application whose sessions are being analyzed

threshold.description: Numeric score above which a session is considered anomalous

timeWindow.description: Duration (e.g., "24h", "7d") over which session data is aggregated for analysis

function.name: userRetentionForecast
function.description: Generates a forecast of future user retention rates for a given application by applying statistical or machine‑learning models to historical activity data, helping product teams plan engagement strategies.

appID.description: Identifier of the application for which retention is forecasted

modelVersion.description: Optional version tag of the forecasting model to use

function.name: recommendOutdoorActivities
function.description: Provide suggestions for suitable outdoor activities based on forecasted weather conditions for a location and a date range, taking user preferences into account.

location.description: Target location for the activity recommendations.

dateRange.description: Start and end dates for the recommendation period, expressed as ISO range (e.g., "2023-09-01/2023-09-07").

preferences.description: Optional user preferences such as activity type (hiking, cycling, picnic) or intensity level.

function.name: getHistoricalWeatherAlerts
function.description: Retrieve archived weather warning records for a specific region within a given date range, optionally filtered by alert type.

region.description: The geographic region or location identifier (e.g., city name, coordinates).

startDate.description: Start date of the period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: End date of the period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

alertType.description: Specific type of weather alert to filter (e.g., flood, tornado).

function.name: assessClimateEventRisk
function.description: Estimate the risk level of selected climate-related hazards for a location over a specified future horizon, using historical patterns and model projections.

location.description: Target location expressed as a city name, coordinates, or region code.

horizonDays.description: Number of days into the future to assess risk (e.g., "30" for a month).

hazardTypes.description: Comma‑separated list of hazards to evaluate (e.g., "flood,heatwave,storm").

function.name: getPollutantEmissionReport
function.description: Produce a detailed report of the primary emission sources for a selected pollutant at a given location, breaking down contributions from traffic, industry, residential heating, and natural sources.

location.description: The target location (city, region, or coordinates) for which the emission source analysis is required.

pollutant.description: The specific pollutant symbol or name (e.g., PM2.5, NO2, SO2) to analyze.

year.description: The calendar year for which the emission data should be considered, in YYYY format.

detailLevel.description: Level of detail for the report (summary or detailed).

function.name: getMoonPhase
function.description: Returns the lunar phase (e.g., New Moon, Waxing Crescent, Full Moon) for a given date and geographic location.

date.description: The date for which to determine the moon phase, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

location.description: Latitude and longitude of the location, formatted as "lat,lon".

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., "Asia/Shanghai") to adjust the phase time if needed.

function.name: getSolarElevation
function.description: Calculates the solar elevation angle for a specific moment at a given location.

datetime.description: The date and time for the calculation in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-08-16T14:30:00").

location.description: Latitude and longitude of the point, formatted as "lat,lon".

units.description: Unit for the angle output: "degrees" or "radians".

function.name: getAirportRunwayInfo
function.description: Provides detailed specifications for runways at a given airport, including length, width, surface type, and lighting.

airportCode.description: IATA or ICAO code of the airport.

runwayId.description: Identifier of a specific runway (e.g., '09L'). If omitted, information for all runways is returned.

function.name: getAirportNoiseProcedures
function.description: Provide the noise abatement procedures and related restrictions for a specified airport, such as preferred departure/arrival routes, altitude limits, and time‑based noise curfews.

airportIcao.description: The ICAO code of the airport for which noise procedures are requested.

detailLevel.description: Level of detail to return: 'summary' for a brief overview, 'full' for complete procedural documentation.

function.name: getAirportRunwayDetails
function.description: Provides detailed runway specifications for a given airport, including runway identifiers, lengths, widths, surface materials, orientation, lighting, and available instrument landing system types.

airportCode.description: IATA or ICAO code of the airport whose runway data is requested.

includeLighting.description: If set to "true", include runway lighting and approach light system details.

function.name: getAirportSecurityWaitTimes
function.description: Returns estimated passenger security checkpoint waiting times for a given airport on a particular date and optional time window.

airportCode.description: IATA or ICAO code of the airport.

date.description: Date for the wait time estimate in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timeWindow.description: Specific time range or period of the day (e.g., "08:00-10:00" or "evening"). Optional.

function.name: getPlayerClanInfo
function.description: Retrieves information about the clan a RuneScape player belongs to, such as clan name, rank, and join date. Can optionally include the full list of clan members.

playerName.description: The exact RuneScape username of the player

includeMembers.description: Set to true to include a list of all members in the clan

function.name: getItemMarketData
function.description: Fetches the current market board price, quantity available, and recent price history for a specific Final Fantasy XIV item.

itemIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of the item whose market data is being requested.

region.description: The server region to query (e.g., 'NA', 'EU', 'JP').

function.name: getQuestLocationMap
function.description: Returns geographic coordinates and map overlays for all key locations associated with a given RuneScape quest, allowing players to visualize quest hotspots on the world map.

questId.description: The unique identifier of the quest whose location data is requested.

overlayStyle.description: Optional style for the map overlay (e.g., simple, detailed).

function.name: manageClan
function.description: Create, modify, or delete RuneScape clans, including setting clan name, description, and recruitment policies.

clanId.description: Unique identifier of the clan (or null for creation).

operation.description: Action to perform: create, update, or delete.

settings.description: JSON string with clan settings such as name, description, and recruitment mode.

function.name: scheduleGameEvent
function.description: Schedule a timed in‑game event in RuneScape, specifying the event type, start time, and duration.

eventType.description: The type of event to schedule (e.g., doubleXP, bossSpawn, holidayFestival).

startTime.description: ISO‑8601 timestamp indicating when the event should begin.

durationMinutes.description: Length of the event in minutes.

function.name: getMonsterSpawnPoints
function.description: Provides detailed locations and regions where a specific monster appears in RuneScape, including coordinates, map zones, and time‑based spawn windows.

monsterId.description: The unique numeric identifier of the monster in the game.

region.description: Optional name of a specific region or area to limit the spawn location results.

function.name: getMonsterLore
function.description: Returns narrative background, myths, and in‑game lore for a given monster, covering its origins, notable encounters, and cultural significance within RuneScape.

monsterName.description: The display name of the monster whose lore is requested.

includeMyths.description: If true, include additional mythic stories and folklore related to the monster.

function.name: simulateWeaponCombat
function.description: Simulates a combat encounter between two weapons, estimating hit chance, damage per second and win probability based on attacker and defender weapon IDs and optional character levels.

attackerWeaponId.description: ID of the weapon used by the attacker.

defenderWeaponId.description: ID of the weapon used by the defender.

attackerLevel.description: Combat level of the attacker (optional, defaults to 1).

defenderLevel.description: Combat level of the defender (optional, defaults to 1).

function.name: trackWeaponMarketTrends
function.description: Provides historical market price data and trend analysis for a specific RuneScape weapon over a given time period.

weaponId.description: ID of the weapon to query.

timeRange.description: Time range for the trend data (e.g., '7d', '30d', '1y').

function.name: getSkillTrainingLocations
function.description: Provides a list of in‑game locations where a specified RuneScape skill can be trained, including level requirements and typical experience rates.

region.description: Optional filter for a specific game region or world (e.g., "Karamja", "Tirannwn").

function.name: getCountryNeighbors
function.description: Provide a list of countries that share a land border with the given country, including the length of each shared border when requested.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 or alpha‑3 code of the target country

includeBorderLength.description: If true, the response includes the length of each border in kilometers

function.name: getDivisionBoundaries
function.description: Returns the geographic boundary of a specific administrative division as a spatial data format (e.g., GeoJSON or KML).

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country.

divisionCode.description: Official code or identifier of the administrative division.

format.description: Desired output format for the boundary data, such as 'geojson' or 'kml'.

function.name: getDivisionCulturalHeritage
function.description: Provides a list of cultural heritage sites located within a specified administrative division, including site name and brief description.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country.

divisionCode.description: Official code or identifier of the administrative division.

category.description: Optional filter for heritage site category (e.g., 'museum', 'historic', 'archaeological').

function.name: exportDivisionStatistics
function.description: Exports selected statistical metrics for specified administrative divisions of a country into a structured file format such as CSV or JSON.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 code of the country containing the divisions.

divisionCodes.description: List of division codes (e.g., province or state identifiers) to include in the export.

metrics.description: Names of statistical metrics to retrieve (e.g., population, GDP, area).

format.description: Desired output file format; defaults to CSV if omitted.

function.name: findDivisionByCoordinates
function.description: Identifies the administrative division that contains a given geographic coordinate pair, optionally constrained to a specific country.

latitude.description: Latitude of the point in decimal degrees (e.g., "45.4215").

longitude.description: Longitude of the point in decimal degrees (e.g., "-75.6972").

countryCode.description: Optional ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 country code to limit the search scope.

function.name: listCountryTimezones
function.description: Provide a list of all IANA time zone identifiers applicable to a given country.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code of the country.

includeOffsets.description: If true, include the current UTC offset for each time zone.

function.name: generateStaticMapSnapshot
function.description: Creates a static image of a Google Maps view with optional markers and styling, suitable for embedding in documents or reports.

center.description: Latitude and longitude of the map centre, formatted as 'lat,lng'.

size.description: Dimensions of the image in pixels, e.g., '800x600'.

mapStyle.description: Map style identifier such as 'roadmap', 'satellite', 'terrain', or 'hybrid'.

markers.description: Optional list of markers to include in the snapshot.

function.name: calculateTravelTime
function.description: Estimates travel time and distance between two geographic coordinates using a selected transportation mode.

origin.description: Starting point latitude and longitude in 'lat,lon' format.

destination.description: Ending point latitude and longitude in 'lat,lon' format.

departureTime.description: Desired departure time in ISO 8601 format; defaults to now if omitted.

function.name: searchNearbyPlaces
function.description: Finds points of interest around a given location filtered by keyword and radius.

location.description: Center point latitude and longitude in 'lat,lon' format.

keyword.description: Search term to filter places, e.g., 'cafe', 'museum'.

function.name: generateHeatmapLayer
function.description: Create a heatmap overlay on a specified Google Maps instance using a collection of geographic points, allowing customization of point intensity, radius, and color gradient.

mapId.description: Identifier of the target Google Map where the heatmap will be added.

points.description: List of geographic points to include in the heatmap. Each point should be an object with latitude and longitude fields.

weight.description: Optional weight representing the intensity contribution of the point.

radius.description: Radius in meters for each heat point, affecting the spread of the heatmap.

gradient.description: Array of CSS color strings defining the gradient from low to high intensity.

function.name: calculateOptimizedRoute
function.description: Compute an optimized travel route between multiple waypoints on a Google Map, returning a route identifier and optional travel statistics based on the selected travel mode and preferences.

mapId.description: Identifier of the Google Map for which the route is being calculated.

waypoints.description: Ordered list of locations defining the route. Each waypoint is an object with latitude and longitude.

travelMode.description: Mode of travel for the route (e.g., driving, walking, bicycling, transit).

avoidTolls.description: If true, the routing algorithm will avoid toll roads when possible.

function.name: getWalletBalance
function.description: Retrieve the current Bitcoin balance of a specified wallet, including confirmed and unconfirmed amounts.

walletId.description: The unique identifier of the wallet whose balance is being queried.

includeUnconfirmed.description: If set to "true", include unconfirmed transaction amounts in the returned balance.

function.name: generateReceivingAddress
function.description: Create a new Bitcoin receiving address for an existing wallet, optionally assigning a label for identification.

walletId.description: The identifier of the wallet for which to generate the address.

addressLabel.description: An optional human‑readable label to associate with the new address.

function.name: analyzeSourceSentiment
function.description: Calculates aggregated sentiment metrics for articles published by a specific news source over a given time period, returning average sentiment and a distribution breakdown.

source.description: Name or identifier of the news source to analyze.

startDate.description: Start date (inclusive) for the analysis in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: End date (inclusive) for the analysis in YYYY-MM-DD format.

language.description: Optional language filter for the articles (e.g., en, zh).

function.name: extractArticleImages
function.description: Retrieves all image URLs embedded within a news article identified by its web address. Optionally includes the image captions if requested.

articleUrl.description: The full URL of the news article to extract images from.

includeCaptions.description: If true, also return the captions associated with each image.

function.name: estimateGasFee
function.description: Calculate an estimated gas fee for a blockchain transaction based on the sender, receiver, and value, using current network conditions and fee market data.

fromAddress.description: The blockchain address initiating the transaction.

toAddress.description: The blockchain address receiving the transaction.

value.description: The amount of cryptocurrency to be transferred, expressed in the smallest unit (e.g., wei).

priorityLevel.description: Desired transaction priority such as "low", "medium", or "high", influencing the fee estimation.

function.name: trackAddressActivity
function.description: Retrieve a chronological list of transactions involving a specific blockchain address within an optional date range, including details like transaction hash, timestamp, amount, and counterparties.

address.description: The blockchain address to monitor for activity.

startDate.description: ISO‑8601 date string marking the beginning of the lookup period (inclusive).

endDate.description: ISO‑8601 date string marking the end of the lookup period (inclusive).

includeInternal.description: Flag indicating whether to include internal contract calls ("true" or "false").

function.name: getArticleCitationCount
function.description: Fetch the number of citations an arXiv paper has received from a chosen citation database, optionally indicating the source of the count.

articleId.description: The arXiv identifier of the article to query.

source.description: The citation database to use, such as "SemanticScholar" or "Crossref".

function.name: estimateTransactionFee
function.description: Calculate the expected transaction fee for a given blockchain network based on current network congestion and desired confirmation speed.

network.description: Name of the blockchain network (e.g., bitcoin, ethereum, solana).

priority.description: Desired confirmation priority: low, medium, or high.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the transaction in bytes, if known.

function.name: refundPaymentById
function.description: Initiates a refund for a specific Rappi order payment, returning the specified amount to the customer's original payment method.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the Rappi order whose payment is to be refunded.

amount.description: The amount to refund in the order's currency.

currency.description: Three‑letter ISO code of the currency for the refund (e.g., USD, EUR).

reason.description: Optional explanation for the refund request.

function.name: checkPaymentStatus
function.description: Retrieves the current status of a payment transaction associated with a Rappi order, indicating whether it is pending, completed, failed, or refunded.

payment_id.description: The unique identifier of the payment transaction to query.

order_id.description: The Rappi order identifier, if known, to narrow the lookup.

function.name: monitorKeywordSentiment
function.description: Analyzes sentiment trends for a given keyword across news articles within a date range, returning aggregated positive, neutral, and negative scores.

keyword.description: Keyword or phrase to monitor in news articles

startDate.description: Start date for the analysis period in YYYY-MM-DD format

endDate.description: End date for the analysis period in YYYY-MM-DD format

language.description: Language code to filter articles (e.g., en, de, zh)

function.name: getArxivCitationStats
function.description: Retrieve citation statistics for a given arXiv paper, including total citation count, list of citing works, and optionally the paper's reference list.

articleId.description: The unique identifier of the arXiv paper (e.g., 2104.12345).

includeReferences.description: If set to "true", the response will also contain the paper's reference list.

function.name: compareComponents
function.description: Compare specifications (e.g., clock speed, core count, power consumption) of multiple electronic component part numbers and return a side‑by‑side matrix highlighting differences and similarities.

partNumbers.description: List of component part numbers to compare

attributes.description: Specific attributes to include in the comparison, such as "clockSpeed", "cores", "power". If omitted, all available attributes are compared.

function.name: componentComplianceCheck
function.description: Verify whether a given electronic component part complies with regulatory standards (e.g., RoHS, REACH, FCC) for a specified region and provide details of any violations.

partNumber.description: The component part number to check

region.description: Geographic region or market (e.g., "EU", "US", "APAC")

complianceType.description: Specific compliance standard to verify, such as "RoHS", "REACH", "FCC". If omitted, all known standards for the region are evaluated.

function.name: compareComponentSpecs
function.description: Generates a side‑by‑side comparison of technical specifications for a list of electronic component part numbers, highlighting differences in features such as clock speed, core count, voltage, and package type.

partNumbers.description: Array of component part numbers to include in the comparison.

function.name: componentRegulatoryCheck
function.description: Checks whether a given electronic component complies with specified regulatory standards such as RoHS, REACH, or FCC for a particular market region.

partNumber.description: The part number of the component to evaluate.

region.description: Geographic region or market (e.g., EU, US, China) whose regulations should be applied.

standards.description: Optional list of specific standards to check (e.g., "RoHS", "REACH"). If omitted, a default set for the region is used.

function.name: requestSample
function.description: Submit a request to receive physical samples of a specific electronic component for evaluation or testing, specifying quantity and shipping details.

partNumber.description: The unique identifier of the component to be sampled.

shippingAddress.description: Full address where the sample should be delivered.

contactEmail.description: Email address to receive notifications about the sample shipment status.

function.name: manageWarranty
function.description: Check warranty status or file a warranty claim for electronic components, providing part and serial information along with the issue details.

serialNumber.description: Serial number of the specific unit.

customerID.description: Identifier of the customer requesting warranty service.

action.description: Specify whether to query warranty status or submit a claim.

issueDescription.description: Detailed description of the defect or issue, required when action is 'claim'.

function.name: trackCustomsStatus
function.description: Retrieve the customs clearance and inspection status for a specific electronic component shipment.

orderID.description: The unique identifier of the shipment order.

customsAuthority.description: Name or code of the customs authority handling the clearance (optional).

function.name: setupDeliveryAlert
function.description: Schedule a notification to be sent when a component shipment reaches a particular delivery status such as delivered, delayed, or exception.

orderID.description: The unique identifier of the shipment order.

alertMethod.description: Method of alert delivery, e.g., email, SMS, or push notification.

recipient.description: Contact information of the alert recipient (email address or phone number).

function.name: simulateThermalProfile
function.description: Runs a thermal simulation for a given electronic component part number based on ambient temperature and power dissipation, returning estimated junction temperature and recommended cooling solutions.

partNumber.description: The component part number to simulate.

powerDissipation.description: Power dissipation of the component in watts.

function.name: getFiscalYearStartDate
function.description: Provides the starting month and day of the fiscal year for a given country or jurisdiction, optionally for a specific calendar year.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country.

year.description: The calendar year (YYYY) for which the fiscal year start is requested. If omitted, the current year is assumed.

function.name: getHolidayObservanceDetails
function.description: Provides cultural and operational details about how a specific holiday is observed in a given country, including typical customs, public sector closures, and common celebration practices.

country.description: The country for which the holiday observance information is requested (e.g., 'Japan').

holiday_name.description: The official name of the holiday (e.g., 'Golden Week').

function.name: getHolidayMarketImpact
function.description: Returns information on how a particular holiday influences financial markets and business operations in a specified country and year, such as stock exchange closures and trading volume changes.

country.description: The country whose market impact is being queried.

year.description: The year of the holiday (e.g., '2023').

market.description: The type of market or sector (e.g., 'stock', 'banking', 'bond').

holiday_name.description: Optional name of the holiday to narrow the impact details.

function.name: getNextObservedHoliday
function.description: Find the next public holiday that will be observed after a given date for a particular country, taking into account weekend shift rules where holidays may be moved to the nearest weekday.

date.description: The reference date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for which to look up holidays.

function.name: trackDomainHistory
function.description: Retrieves historical DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, etc.) for a specified domain over a given time window, allowing analysis of how the domain's resolution has changed.

domain.description: The fully qualified domain name to query (e.g., example.com).

startDate.description: The start date of the period to retrieve records, in ISO‑8601 format (YYYY‑MM‑DD).

endDate.description: The end date of the period to retrieve records, in ISO‑8601 format (YYYY‑MM‑DD).

function.name: monitorHostUptime
function.description: Periodically probes a host's IP address over a defined period and returns uptime statistics such as total uptime, downtime, and availability percentage.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the host to monitor.

periodDays.description: Number of days to run the monitoring period.

checkIntervalMinutes.description: Interval in minutes between successive health‑check probes.

function.name: auditTlsCipherSuites
function.description: Analyze the TLS configuration of a server and report weak or deprecated cipher suites and protocol versions.

hostname.description: The domain name or IP address of the target server.

port.description: The TCP port on which the TLS service is listening (default 443).

includeDeprecated.description: Whether to include deprecated cipher suites in the report.

function.name: detectPhishingUrls
function.description: Examine a list of URLs and identify those that exhibit characteristics of phishing or social engineering attacks.

urls.description: Array of URLs to be evaluated.

checkBrand.description: Optional brand name to compare against in the URL for targeted phishing detection.

function.name: measureHostLatency
function.description: Measure round‑trip latency (ping) to a given IP address or hostname and return statistics such as minimum, maximum, average and packet loss.

target.description: IP address or hostname to ping.

packetCount.description: Number of ICMP echo requests to send. Default is 4.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for each reply in seconds.

function.name: exportHostInventory
function.description: Create a downloadable inventory file (CSV or JSON) containing selected metadata for a list of hosts, such as IP, open ports, DNS records, location and software version.

ipList.description: Array of IP addresses to include in the inventory.

format.description: Desired output format.

function.name: forecastEconomicTrends
function.description: Predicts future values of selected economic indicators for a given country over a specified time horizon using historical data and statistical models.

country.description: ISO country code or name for which the forecast is requested

indicator.description: Economic indicator to forecast (e.g., GDP, inflation, unemployment rate)

startYear.description: Starting year of the forecast period (e.g., 2025)

endYear.description: Ending year of the forecast period (e.g., 2030)

model.description: Optional forecasting model to use (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet)

function.name: generateEconomicReport
function.description: Creates a concise report summarizing economic performance of a selected sector in a given country and period, optionally including charts and tables.

country.description: ISO country code or name for the report

sector.description: Economic sector to focus on (e.g., tourism, manufacturing, services)

period.description: Time period for the report (e.g., 2022 Q1, 2020-2022)

format.description: Desired output format such as pdf, html, or markdown

function.name: recommendDatasets
function.description: Suggest a list of open datasets that best match a user’s interests, preferred topics, and optional keyword filters. The tool ranks results by relevance and returns basic identifiers and brief summaries.

userInterests.description: A list of topics, domains, or themes the user is interested in (e.g., "environment", "public health").

keywords.description: Optional additional keywords to narrow the recommendation.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of dataset suggestions to return.

function.name: trackDatasetUpdates
function.description: Registers an email address to receive notifications whenever the specified dataset is refreshed, corrected, or has its metadata changed.

datasetId.description: Identifier of the dataset to monitor.

email.description: Email address where update notifications will be sent.

frequency.description: How often to send notifications (e.g., daily, weekly).

function.name: convertDatasetFormat
function.description: Converts a specified Cypriot government dataset from its original format to a desired output format, optionally preserving metadata.

datasetId.description: Identifier of the dataset to be converted.

targetFormat.description: Desired output format (e.g., csv, json, xml).

preserveMetadata.description: Whether to include original metadata in the converted file (true or false).

function.name: generateDatasetReport
function.description: Produce a statistical summary report of a given dataset, including record count, field types, and sample rows, in the requested format.

datasetId.description: Identifier of the dataset to analyze.

reportFormat.description: Desired output format for the report, such as PDF, HTML, or JSON.

includeSample.description: Whether to include example rows from the dataset.

function.name: getDatasetCitation
function.description: Generate a properly formatted citation for a German government dataset, optionally using a specified citation style such as APA, MLA, or Chicago.

datasetId.description: Unique identifier of the German government dataset.

style.description: Citation style to use (e.g., APA, MLA, Chicago).

includeAccessDate.description: Whether to append the date the dataset was accessed to the citation.

outputLanguage.description: Language in which the citation should be generated.

function.name: compareRegionalStatistics
function.description: Compares a specified statistical category between two regions or countries over a given time span and returns a summary of differences, percentage changes, and ranking.

regionA.description: The first region or country to compare (e.g., Sweden, Germany).

regionB.description: The second region or country to compare.

category.description: The statistical category to compare (e.g., population, unemployment).

startYear.description: The beginning year of the comparison period.

endYear.description: The ending year of the comparison period.

function.name: generateStatisticalProjection
function.description: Projects future values for a chosen statistical indicator of a region based on historical data using a selected forecasting method.

region.description: The region or country for which the projection is needed.

category.description: The statistical category to project (e.g., GDP, life expectancy).

baseYear.description: The most recent year with available data to base the projection on.

targetYear.description: The future year for which the projection is requested.

method.description: Forecasting method to use (e.g., linear, exponential).

function.name: getSwedishDataArchive
function.description: Retrieve archived open datasets published by the Swedish government for a specified time period and optional category.

year.description: Four‑digit year of the archive to retrieve (e.g., "2022").

month.description: Two‑digit month number (01‑12). Optional; if omitted the whole year is returned.

category.description: Specific dataset category to filter the archive (e.g., "health", "transport").

function.name: getSwedishDatasetLicense
function.description: Fetch licensing and usage terms for a given Swedish government dataset identifier.

datasetId.description: Unique identifier of the Swedish dataset.

includeFullText.description: If set to "true", returns the full license text; otherwise only a summary is provided.

function.name: monitorDatasetChanges
function.description: Track and retrieve a log of modifications, additions, or deletions made to a specific German government dataset since a given date.

datasetId.description: The unique identifier of the German government dataset to monitor.

since.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY‑MM‑DD) from which to start tracking changes.

function.name: detectSongKey
function.description: Analyzes an audio file or song metadata to determine the musical key and mode (e.g., C major, A minor).

audioUrl.description: Direct URL to the audio file of the song to be analyzed.

metadata.description: Optional textual metadata such as artist, title, or album to aid the analysis.

function.name: generateChordProgression
function.description: Creates a chord progression based on a specified genre, mood, and optional key.

genre.description: Musical genre to influence the style of the progression (e.g., rock, jazz).

mood.description: Desired emotional tone such as happy, melancholic, energetic.

key.description: Optional musical key for the progression (e.g., G major).

length.description: Number of chords desired in the progression.

function.name: getConcertsByArtist
function.description: Retrieve upcoming live performance dates, venues, and ticket information for a specified artist.

artist.description: Name of the artist whose concerts are being queried.

location.description: Optional city or country to filter concerts.

dateRange.description: Optional ISO 8601 date range (e.g., "2024-01-01/2024-12-31") to limit results.

function.name: generateAlbumCover
function.description: Creates an AI‑generated album cover image based on the musical genre, visual style, and optional title text provided.

genre.description: The music genre to reflect in the visual theme (e.g., rock, jazz, electronic).

style.description: Artistic style for the cover such as minimalist, retro, abstract, or photorealistic.

title.description: Optional text to display on the cover, typically the album or song title.

function.name: trackTrendAnalysis
function.description: Analyzes historical popularity trends for songs, artists, or genres over a specified time window and returns statistical insights such as growth rate, peak periods, and comparative rankings.

entity.description: The type of entity to analyze: "song", "artist", or "genre".

identifier.description: The name or ID of the specific song, artist, or genre to analyze.

startDate.description: The start date of the analysis period in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2022-01-01").

endDate.description: The end date of the analysis period in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2023-12-31").

metric.description: The popularity metric to evaluate, such as "streamCount", "chartPosition", or "growthRate".

function.name: concertEventLookup
function.description: Finds upcoming live concert or event information for a specified artist, venue, or geographic region, including dates, locations, and ticket availability.

artist.description: Name of the artist or band whose events are being queried.

city.description: City name to limit the search to a specific location.

country.description: Country name for broader geographic filtering.

dateRange.description: Desired date range for events in ISO 8601 format, e.g., "2024-06-01/2024-12-31".

function.name: echoCookies
function.description: Extracts cookie data from an HTTP request and returns a mapping of cookie names to their values.

cookieHeader.description: The raw Cookie header string received in the request.

decode.description: If true, URL‑decode each cookie value before returning.

function.name: echoRedirect
function.description: Simulates an HTTP redirect response, returning the redirect status code and the target URL in a Location header.

targetUrl.description: The URL to which the client should be redirected.

statusCode.description: HTTP redirect status code, typically 301, 302, 303, 307, or 308.

function.name: manageCookies
function.description: Simulates setting, updating, and retrieving HTTP cookies for a request, returning the current cookie jar as a JSON object.

action.description: The cookie operation to perform: 'set', 'get', or 'delete'.

cookieName.description: Name of the cookie to set, retrieve, or delete.

cookieValue.description: Value to assign to the cookie when action is 'set'.

attributes.description: Optional cookie attributes such as expires, path, domain, and secure.

function.name: simulateRedirect
function.description: Generates a simulated HTTP redirect response by providing a target URL and optional redirect method, returning the redirect location and status information.

targetUrl.description: The URL to which the request should be redirected.

redirectMethod.description: HTTP method to use after redirection, e.g., 'GET' or 'POST'.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code for the redirect, default is '302'.

function.name: extractHeaderValues
function.description: Given a collection of HTTP request headers and a list of header names, returns the corresponding values for each requested header. Missing headers are reported as null.

headers.description: A map of header names to their values as received in the HTTP request.

fields.description: List of header names whose values should be extracted.

function.name: mergeHeaders
function.description: Combines a base set of HTTP headers with an overriding set, applying the overrides and returning the resulting header collection. Useful for constructing final request headers after defaults and custom values are considered.

baseHeaders.description: Default HTTP headers that should be present unless overridden.

overrideHeaders.description: Headers that should replace or add to the baseHeaders.

function.name: generateApiKey
function.description: Creates a new API key for a specified user, optionally limited by scopes and expiration time, and returns the key string along with metadata.

userId.description: Identifier of the user for whom the API key is being generated.

scopes.description: List of permission scopes to embed in the API key.

expiresIn.description: Lifetime of the API key in seconds; if omitted the key does not expire.

function.name: validateCsrfToken
function.description: Checks whether a provided CSRF token matches the expected token for a given session and optional origin, returning a boolean validation result.

sessionId.description: The identifier of the user session to which the CSRF token should belong.

csrfToken.description: The CSRF token supplied by the client.

origin.description: The origin URL of the request; used for stricter validation when provided.

function.name: generateAnalogousPalette
function.description: Create a palette of colors that are analogous to a base color, optionally specifying how many adjacent hues to include on each side of the base hue.

baseColor.description: The starting color from which analogous hues will be derived, given as a hex code or other CSS-supported format.

steps.description: Number of analogous colors to generate on each side of the base hue (default is 2).

hueShift.description: Degrees to shift hue for each step; positive values move clockwise around the color wheel.

function.name: simulateColorBlindness
function.description: Generate a representation of a color as perceived by a specific type of color‑blind vision.

color.description: The original color value (hex, rgb, etc.).

blindnessType.description: The type of color blindness to simulate (e.g., deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia).

function.name: blendColors
function.description: Blend two colors together using a specified weight, producing a new mixed color.

colorA.description: The first color to blend, in any standard format.

colorB.description: The second color to blend, in any standard format.

weight.description: Weight of the first color in the blend (0.0 to 1.0). The second color weight is inferred as 1 - weight.

function.name: generateAnalogousColors
function.description: Generate a set of colors that are analogous to the given base color, useful for creating harmonious color schemes.

baseColor.description: The reference color in any standard format (hex, rgb, etc.).

count.description: Number of analogous colors to generate (default is 3).

function.name: mixColors
function.description: Blend two input colors together using a specified mixing ratio to produce a new color.

color1.description: The first color value in any standard format (e.g., hex, rgb).

color2.description: The second color value in any standard format.

ratio.description: A decimal between 0 and 1 indicating the proportion of color1 in the blend (default 0.5).

function.name: analyzeTweetSentiment
function.description: Analyzes the sentiment of tweets that match a given search query within an optional time window and returns an overall sentiment score along with sample positive and negative tweets.

query.description: The search query or keywords to match tweets.

start_time.description: ISO‑8601 timestamp marking the start of the analysis period (optional).

end_time.description: ISO‑8601 timestamp marking the end of the analysis period (optional).

language.description: Language code (e.g., "en") to filter tweets (optional).

sample_size.description: Maximum number of tweets to sample for sentiment extraction (optional).

include_retweets.description: Whether to include retweets in the analysis (default false).

function.name: aggregateHashtagMetrics
function.description: Calculates aggregate engagement metrics for a specific hashtag, such as total tweet count, average likes, and average retweets, over a defined period.

include_retweets.description: If true, retweets are counted in the metrics; otherwise they are excluded.

min_likes.description: Minimum number of likes a tweet must have to be included in the aggregation (optional).

min_retweets.description: Minimum number of retweets a tweet must have to be included in the aggregation (optional).

function.name: trackHashtagVolume
function.description: Continuously monitors the Twitter firehose for a specific hashtag and returns the number of matching tweets observed in each time interval.

hashtag.description: The hashtag (without the leading #) to track in the live tweet stream.

intervalSeconds.description: Length of each reporting interval in seconds. Default is 60.

location.description: Optional bounding box in 'lon1,lat1,lon2,lat2' format to limit the stream to a geographic area.

function.name: translateTweetStream
function.description: Translates the text of real‑time tweets from a source language to a target language as they are streamed.

sourceLanguage.description: ISO 639‑1 code of the language of incoming tweets (e.g., 'en' for English).

targetLanguage.description: ISO 639‑1 code of the language to translate tweets into (e.g., 'es' for Spanish).

track.description: Keyword or phrase to filter the tweet stream before translation.

function.name: getUserVerificationStatus
function.description: Retrieve the verification status of a specified Twitter user, indicating whether the account is verified and providing the verification date if available.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the Twitter user.

include_date.description: Whether to include the date when the account was verified.

function.name: getUserLikedTweets
function.description: Fetch a list of tweet IDs that a specified Twitter user has liked, with optional pagination support.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the Twitter user.

max_results.description: Maximum number of liked tweets to return (default 20).

pagination_token.description: Token for fetching the next page of results.

function.name: getUserMuteList
function.description: Retrieve the list of Twitter accounts that a specified user has muted, with optional pagination.

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the Twitter user whose mute list is being requested.

count.description: Maximum number of muted accounts to return per request.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to retrieve the next set of muted accounts.

function.name: getTrendingTopics
function.description: Fetch the current trending topics for a specific location identified by its Yahoo! GeoPlanet WOEID.

woeid.description: Yahoo! GeoPlanet Where On Earth ID representing the location.

limit.description: Maximum number of trending topics to return.

function.name: getExchangeFees
function.description: Retrieve the trading fee schedule for a specific cryptocurrency pair on the exchange, including taker and optionally maker fees.

includeMaker.description: If true, include the maker fee in the response; otherwise only taker fee is returned.

function.name: monitorNetworkHealth
function.description: Provide current blockchain network health metrics such as hash rate, difficulty, average block time, and recent block height for a specified cryptocurrency.

asset.description: The cryptocurrency symbol to monitor (e.g., ETH, BTC).

network.description: Optional specific network name if multiple (e.g., mainnet, testnet).

function.name: calculateVolatility
function.description: Computes the statistical volatility of a given cryptocurrency over a specified period using historical price data, optionally returning confidence intervals.

symbol_id.description: Identifier of the cryptocurrency symbol, e.g., BTC or ETH.

period_id.description: Time period identifier for the volatility calculation, such as '1d', '1w', or '1m'.

confidence_level.description: Desired confidence level for the volatility estimate (e.g., 0.95 for 95% confidence).

include_drawdown.description: If true, also returns the maximum drawdown observed during the period.

function.name: fetchCryptoNews
function.description: Retrieve recent news articles and headlines related to a specific cryptocurrency, optionally limiting the number of results or filtering by date.

currency.description: The ticker symbol or name of the cryptocurrency (e.g., ETH, Bitcoin).

limit.description: Maximum number of news items to return.

since_date.description: ISO‑8601 date to fetch news published on or after this date.

function.name: getCryptoAssetInfo
function.description: Retrieve static metadata for a given cryptocurrency asset, such as its full name, ticker symbol, launch date, total supply, consensus algorithm, official website and description.

asset_id.description: The unique identifier or ticker of the cryptocurrency (e.g., 'BTC', 'ETH', 'XRP').

fields.description: Specific metadata fields to return (e.g., ['launch_date','total_supply']). If omitted, all available fields are returned.

function.name: listSupportedExchanges
function.description: Provide a catalog of cryptocurrency exchanges that are integrated with the platform, including exchange name, identifier, country of operation, and basic fee information.

region.description: Filter exchanges by geographic region or country code (e.g., 'US', 'EU').

include_fees.description: If true, include detailed trading fee structures for each exchange.

function.name: computeOrderBookImbalance
function.description: Calculate the imbalance between buy and sell sides of an order book for a given cryptocurrency pair and depth level, returning a numeric score indicating market pressure.

symbol_id.description: Identifier of the cryptocurrency trading pair (e.g., BTC-USD).

depth.description: Number of price levels from the top of the book to include in the calculation.

function.name: subscribeOrderBookUpdates
function.description: Create a real-time subscription to receive incremental order book updates for a specified cryptocurrency pair, with configurable update frequency and depth.

symbol_id.description: Identifier of the cryptocurrency pair to monitor.

depth.description: Number of order book levels to include in each update.

interval_ms.description: Desired interval between updates in milliseconds.

callback_url.description: Endpoint URL where updates should be posted.

function.name: detectPriceAnomalies
function.description: Analyze recent cryptocurrency market data to identify price spikes or drops that deviate significantly from normal behavior using statistical thresholds.

symbol_id.description: The identifier of the cryptocurrency pair to analyze (e.g., BTC/USD).

window_size.description: Length of the rolling window for analysis, expressed in minutes or hours (e.g., "6h").

threshold.description: Anomaly detection threshold expressed as a percentage deviation (e.g., "5").

function.name: calculateVolatilityIndex
function.description: Compute a volatility index for a given cryptocurrency pair over a specified period using chosen statistical methods such as standard deviation or ATR.

symbol_id.description: The identifier of the cryptocurrency pair (e.g., ETH/EUR).

period_id.description: The time period for which volatility is calculated (e.g., "30d" for thirty days).

method.description: The calculation method to use, such as "standard_deviation" or "atr".

function.name: getVaccinationPolicy
function.description: Retrieves the official COVID‑19 vaccination policy for a specified country, including approved vaccine types, eligibility criteria, rollout phases, and start dates.

country.description: The ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 or full name of the country.

effectiveDate.description: The date (YYYY‑MM‑DD) for which the policy should be retrieved; defaults to the latest available.

function.name: getTravelAdvisory
function.description: Provides current international travel advisory and restriction details for a given country, covering entry requirements, quarantine mandates, testing rules, and any vaccination proof needed.

country.description: The destination country's ISO code or name.

asOfDate.description: The date (YYYY‑MM‑DD) for which the advisory information is requested; defaults to today.

function.name: compareCountryIndicators
function.description: Compares selected statistical indicators between two countries over a defined period, returning side‑by‑side values and calculated differences for each indicator.

countryA.description: ISO‑3 code or name of the first country to compare

countryB.description: ISO‑3 code or name of the second country to compare

indicators.description: List of indicator codes or names to compare (e.g., GDP, literacyRate)

startYear.description: Starting year of the comparison period (YYYY)

endYear.description: Ending year of the comparison period (YYYY)

function.name: getCountryPolicyTimeline
function.description: Retrieves a chronological list of major government policy enactments for a specified country, optionally filtered by policy category and date range.

country.description: ISO‑3 code or name of the country

policyCategory.description: Category of policies to filter (e.g., tax, health, education)

startDate.description: Start date for the timeline in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: End date for the timeline in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

function.name: getGlobalVaccinationData
function.description: Retrieves aggregated worldwide COVID‑19 vaccination statistics, such as total doses administered, people partially vaccinated, and people fully vaccinated, optionally filtered by date or vaccine manufacturer.

date.description: The specific date for which vaccination figures are requested, formatted as YYYY‑MM‑DD.

vaccineType.description: Name of a vaccine brand or technology (e.g., Pfizer, AstraZeneca) to limit the results to that product.

function.name: getCovidPolicyTimeline
function.description: Provides a chronological list of major public‑health policy actions (lockdowns, mask mandates, travel bans, vaccination mandates, etc.) implemented globally or for a specified country, within a given date range.

country.description: ISO‑3166 country code or name to restrict the timeline to a single nation. Omit for a global overview.

startDate.description: Start of the period for which policies are requested, in YYYY‑MM‑DD format.

endDate.description: End of the period for which policies are requested, in YYYY‑MM‑DD format.

function.name: getVaccineDistributionMap
function.description: Provides an interactive map visualizing the distribution of a specified COVID-19 vaccine across countries or regions for a given date.

vaccine.description: Name or identifier of the COVID-19 vaccine (e.g., Pfizer, Moderna, AstraZeneca).

date.description: The date for which to display distribution data in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

mapStyle.description: Visual style of the map, such as "heatmap" or "choropleth".

function.name: forecastVirusTrajectory
function.description: Generates a short‑term forecast of COVID‑19 case counts for a specified region using selected epidemiological models.

region.description: Name of the country, state, or other geographic area to forecast.

forecastDays.description: Number of future days to predict (e.g., 7, 14, 30).

model.description: Epidemiological model to use, such as "SEIR", "ARIMA", or "machineLearning".

function.name: fetchCountryEnergyProfile
function.description: Retrieves detailed energy statistics for a specified country, such as total consumption, production mix, renewable share, and emissions across a given time period.

country.description: ISO alpha-3 code or name of the country.

startYear.description: The beginning year of the period (e.g., "2015").

endYear.description: The ending year of the period (e.g., "2022").

metric.description: Specific energy metric to retrieve, such as "consumption", "production", "renewableShare", or "emissions".

function.name: retrieveCountryEducationStats
function.description: Provides education-related indicators for a country, including literacy rates, school enrollment percentages, graduation rates, and average years of schooling for a specified year or range.

country.description: ISO alpha-3 code or name of the country.

year.description: The year for which the education data is requested (e.g., "2020").

indicator.description: Education indicator to retrieve, such as "literacyRate", "enrollmentPrimary", "graduationRate", or "averageYearsSchooling".

function.name: getEconomicForecasts
function.description: Retrieves projected values for selected macroeconomic indicators for a given country using forecasting models, allowing users to specify a future year or range for the predictions.

country.description: Name of the country for which forecasts are requested

indicators.description: Comma‑separated list of macroeconomic indicators to forecast (e.g., GDP, inflation, unemployment)

forecastYear.description: Future year or range (e.g., "2025" or "2024-2026") for which the forecast is needed

model.description: Optional forecasting model or source to use (e.g., IMF, WorldBank)

confidenceLevel.description: Desired confidence level for the forecast (e.g., "95%")

function.name: compareEconomicIndicators
function.description: Compares specified macroeconomic indicators across multiple countries for a particular year, returning relative differences, rankings, and summary statistics.

countries.description: Comma‑separated list of country names to include in the comparison

indicators.description: Comma‑separated list of indicators to compare (e.g., GDP, unemployment rate)

year.description: The year for which the indicator values should be compared

metric.description: Optional metric to compute (e.g., absolute difference, percentage change)

sortBy.description: Field to sort the results by (e.g., "value", "difference")

function.name: forecastTimeSeries
function.description: Generate short‑term forecasts for a specified macroeconomic time series using built‑in statistical models.

seriesId.description: Identifier of the time series to forecast (e.g., a dataset ID or query string).

horizon.description: Number of future periods to predict (e.g., months or quarters).

function.name: visualizeTimeSeries
function.description: Create a chart image for one or more macroeconomic time series with customizable axes and styling options.

seriesIds.description: List of identifiers for the time series to include in the chart.

timeRange.description: Time interval to display, expressed as 'YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD' or a preset like 'last5years'.

function.name: generateMacroDataChart
function.description: Create a visual representation (e.g., line, bar, or area chart) of a specified macroeconomic indicator over a given time range and return the image in the requested format.

metric.description: The macroeconomic indicator to plot, such as GDP, inflation, or unemployment rate.

country.description: ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 or common name of the country for which the data should be visualized.

startYear.description: The beginning year of the time range (inclusive).

endYear.description: The ending year of the time range (inclusive).

chartType.description: Type of chart to generate (e.g., line, bar, area).

outputFormat.description: Image format for the chart (e.g., png, svg).

function.name: registerMacroDataAlert
function.description: Configure an alert that triggers when a specified macroeconomic indicator for a country exceeds or falls below a threshold, sending a notification via the chosen channel.

metric.description: The macroeconomic indicator to monitor (e.g., GDP growth, inflation).

country.description: The country whose data should be monitored.

threshold.description: Numeric value that the indicator is compared against.

direction.description: Whether the alert fires when the metric goes 'above' or 'below' the threshold.

notificationMethod.description: Method of notification such as email, webhook, or SMS.

function.name: exportLiturgicalCalendar
function.description: Export the Protestant liturgical calendar for a given year into a standard iCalendar (ICS) file that can be imported into personal calendar applications.

year.description: The Gregorian year for which to generate the calendar export.

includeLocalizations.description: Whether to include localized names of festivals and observances.

outputFormat.description: Desired file format for the exported calendar.

function.name: generateReadingPlan
function.description: Create a structured daily reading plan that aligns Protestant liturgical seasons with recommended scripture passages and hymn selections.

year.description: The year for which the reading plan should be generated.

seasonFocus.description: Specific liturgical season to emphasize in the plan.

includeHymns.description: Whether to add recommended hymns for each day.

function.name: translateLiturgicalTexts
function.description: Translate Protestant liturgical texts, prayers, and hymns between languages, preserving theological nuance and formatting. Accepts the original text or a document identifier and returns the translated version.

sourceLang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the source language (e.g., "en" for English).

targetLang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the target language (e.g., "de" for German).

text.description: The full liturgical text to be translated. If a documentId is provided instead, the system will retrieve the stored text.

documentId.description: Optional identifier of a stored liturgical document to translate instead of providing raw text.

function.name: analyzeLiturgicalAttendance
function.description: Generate statistical insights on attendance for Protestant liturgical services, including average attendance, growth trends, and demographic breakdowns, filtered by organization, date range, and specific events.

organizationId.description: Unique identifier of the Protestant organization or congregation.

startDate.description: Start date for the analysis period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: End date for the analysis period in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

eventName.description: Optional name of a specific liturgical event to focus the analysis on.

metrics.description: List of metric identifiers to calculate (e.g., "average", "growthRate", "demographics").

function.name: generateLiturgicalMusicPlaylist
function.description: Create a curated playlist of hymns, psalms, and worship songs appropriate for a specified Protestant liturgical event, including optional preferences for musical style or tradition.

eventName.description: The name of the liturgical event (e.g., Easter, Pentecost).

style.description: Preferred musical style or tradition (e.g., contemporary, traditional, choir).

maxTracks.description: Maximum number of tracks to include in the playlist.

function.name: translateLiturgicalText
function.description: Translate liturgical texts, prayers, or readings from English into a target language while preserving theological nuance and liturgical formatting.

sourceText.description: The original liturgical text in English.

targetLanguage.description: ISO language code of the desired translation (e.g., es, fr, de).

preserveFormatting.description: Whether to keep original line breaks and headings (true/false).

function.name: exportCalendarPdf
function.description: Generate a PDF document of a Protestant organization's calendar for a specified date range, optionally including full event descriptions and formatting options.

organizationId.description: Unique identifier of the Protestant organization whose calendar is to be exported.

dateRange.description: ISO‑8601 date interval for the export, e.g., "2024-01-01/2024-12-31".
