includeDetails.description: If true, include detailed event descriptions and notes in the PDF.

pageLayout.description: Preferred page layout such as "portrait" or "landscape".

function.name: syncCalendarWithExternal
function.description: Synchronize a Protestant organization’s custom calendar with an external calendar service (e.g., Google Calendar, Outlook) using configurable direction and conflict‑resolution policies.

organizationId.description: Unique identifier of the Protestant organization whose calendar will be synced.

externalService.description: Name of the external calendar service to connect to (e.g., "Google", "Outlook").

syncDirection.description: Direction of synchronization: push local to external, pull external to local, or keep both in sync.

conflictResolution.description: Strategy to resolve event conflicts during synchronization.

function.name: getArtistConcerts
function.description: Retrieve a list of upcoming concert events for a given artist, with optional filters for location and date range.

artistId.description: The unique Gaana identifier for the artist.

location.description: City or region to limit the concert search (optional).

startDate.description: Earliest date for the concert search range (optional).

endDate.description: Latest date for the concert search range (optional).

function.name: getArtistSocialMetrics
function.description: Collects social media statistics such as follower counts, post frequency, and engagement rates for a specified anime or manga artist across selected platforms.

artist_id.description: Unique identifier of the artist whose metrics are being requested.

platforms.description: List of social media platforms to include (e.g., twitter, instagram). If omitted, all supported platforms are queried.

function.name: getAlbumReviews
function.description: Retrieve professional reviews and ratings for a specific music album from selected review sources, including reviewer name, score, and review excerpt.

album_id.description: The unique identifier of the album to fetch reviews for.

source.description: Optional name of the review source (e.g., Rolling Stone, Pitchfork).

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return.

function.name: getMusicChartPosition
function.description: Fetch historical chart positions for a music album or track on a specified chart and date, returning rank and movement information.

item_id.description: The unique identifier of the album or track.

item_type.description: Type of the item: either "album" or "track".

chart_name.description: Name of the chart (e.g., Billboard Hot 100, UK Albums Chart).

date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) for which to retrieve the chart position.

function.name: getTrackLyrics
function.description: Fetch the full lyrics of a specified music track, optionally providing a translated version and specifying the language of the lyrics.

track.description: The unique identifier, title, or ISRC code of the track.

language.description: Preferred language code for the lyrics (e.g., "en" for English, "zh" for Chinese).

includeTranslation.description: If true, returns an additional translated version of the lyrics when available.

function.name: getConcertSchedule
function.description: Fetch upcoming concert or live performance dates for a given artist within an optional date range.

artist_id.description: The unique identifier of the artist whose concert schedule is being requested.

start_date.description: The earliest date (YYYY-MM-DD) to include in the schedule.

end_date.description: The latest date (YYYY-MM-DD) to include in the schedule.

function.name: fetchConcertEvents
function.description: Retrieve upcoming concert or live event information for a given artist or location, including dates, venues, and ticket links.

artistName.description: Name of the artist or band.

city.description: City to search for events (optional).

dateFrom.description: Start date for the search range.

dateTo.description: End date for the search range.

function.name: generateNewsSummary
function.description: Create a concise summary for a set of news articles related to a specific topic, optionally limiting language and summary length.

topic.description: The main subject or keyword to summarize news about.

language.description: ISO language code for the language of the summary, e.g., 'en' or 'zh'.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters for the generated summary.

function.name: visualizeNewsTrends
function.description: Generate a visual chart depicting trends (e.g., article volume or sentiment) for a specific topic over a defined period, supporting different chart types.

topic.description: The news topic or keyword to analyze

startDate.description: Start date of the analysis period in YYYY‑MM‑DD format

endDate.description: End date of the analysis period in YYYY‑MM‑DD format

metric.description: Metric to visualize, such as "volume" or "sentiment"

chartType.description: Type of chart to produce (e.g., line, bar, pie)

function.name: recommendBooksByProfile
function.description: Suggests Polish books tailored to a user's reading preferences, past reading history, and favored genres, returning a ranked list of recommendations.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user requesting recommendations

preferredGenres.description: Comma‑separated list of genres the user is interested in

maxResults.description: Maximum number of recommended books to return

function.name: fetchBookReviews
function.description: Retrieve user and critic reviews for a specific book, including rating, reviewer name, and review text.

book_id.description: The unique identifier of the book to fetch reviews for

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return

ratingThreshold.description: Only return reviews with a rating equal to or above this value (e.g., "4" for 4 stars or higher)

function.name: checkLibraryAvailability
function.description: Check the availability status of a Polish book across participating libraries.

isbn.description: International Standard Book Number of the Polish book.

libraryId.description: Identifier of the library to query. If omitted, checks all linked libraries.

function.name: getAuthorBiography
function.description: Retrieve a concise biography of a given author, including birth date, notable achievements, and a brief overview of their literary career.

author_id.description: The unique identifier of the author.

include_works.description: If true, include a short list of the author's most recognized works.

function.name: getBookPricing
function.description: Retrieve current pricing, retailer information, and stock availability for a specified Polish book.

title.description: The exact title of the book.

author.description: Name of the author (optional, helps disambiguate).

retailer.description: Specific retailer to query (e.g., 'empik', 'allegro'). If omitted, returns prices from major retailers.

function.name: compareBookPrices
function.description: Fetch current price listings for a book identified by ISBN from multiple online retailers and return a comparison table.

isbn.description: 13‑digit ISBN of the book to compare prices for.

retailers.description: List of retailer identifiers to include in the comparison (e.g., "Amazon", "BarnesAndNoble"). If omitted, a default set of major retailers is used.

currency.description: Currency code (ISO 4217) for price values, such as "USD" or "EUR".

function.name: shareBookshelf
function.description: Share a personal virtual bookshelf with another user by generating a shareable link or sending an invitation, and set the level of access for the recipient.

bookshelfId.description: Unique identifier of the bookshelf to be shared.

recipientEmail.description: Email address of the person with whom the bookshelf will be shared.

permissionLevel.description: Access level granted to the recipient; read allows viewing only, write allows editing the bookshelf.

function.name: exportBookshelfData
function.description: Export the contents and metadata of a virtual bookshelf to a file format such as CSV or JSON for offline analysis or backup.

bookshelfId.description: Unique identifier of the bookshelf to export.

format.description: Desired output file format for the export.

includeRatings.description: Whether to include user rating information for each book in the exported data.

function.name: getStoreMenu
function.description: Fetches the menu for a specified Rappi store, including categories, items, and optional pricing details.

store_id.description: The unique identifier of the store.

include_prices.description: Whether to include price information for each menu item.

dietary_filter.description: Filter menu items by dietary preference, e.g., "vegan", "gluten-free".

function.name: getStoreDeliveryAreas
function.description: Provides information about the delivery coverage area of a Rappi store, including geographic boundaries and optional estimated delivery times.

store_id.description: The unique identifier of the store.

include_estimated_time.description: If true, returns typical delivery time estimates for each area.

function.name: trackOrderDelivery
function.description: Provides real-time tracking information for a Rappi order, including the current location of the delivery driver and estimated arrival time.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the Rappi order to track.

include_route.description: If set to 'true', includes the full route map of the delivery driver.

function.name: estimateDeliveryTime
function.description: Calculates an estimated delivery time for a Rappi order based on current traffic and restaurant preparation status.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the Rappi order for which to estimate delivery time.

destination_address.description: Optional specific address to refine the ETA calculation.

function.name: issueRefund
function.description: Initiates a refund for a given Rappi order, specifying the amount to be returned, the currency, the method of refund, and an optional reason for the refund.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the order to be refunded.

currency.description: The three‑letter ISO currency code (e.g., USD, CNY).

refund_method.description: The method to use for the refund (e.g., original_payment, store_credit).

reason.description: Optional explanation for why the refund is being issued.

function.name: calculateCommission
function.description: Calculates the platform commission for a specific order based on the order amount, the store's tier, and any applicable promotional discounts.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the order for which the commission is being calculated.

store_id.description: The identifier of the store that fulfilled the order.

order_amount.description: The total monetary value of the order before any deductions.

store_tier.description: The tier level of the store (e.g., basic, premium) which influences commission rates.

discount_code.description: Optional promotional discount code that may affect the commission calculation.

function.name: getLoungeInfo
function.description: Provides details about airport lounges at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, including location, opening hours, eligibility criteria, available amenities, and any associated fees.

terminal.description: The terminal identifier (e.g., 'T1', 'T2') where the lounge is located.

loungeName.description: Specific name of the lounge if known; otherwise returns information for all lounges in the terminal.

membershipLevel.description: The passenger's lounge access membership tier (e.g., 'Priority Pass', 'Airline Gold') to filter eligibility.

function.name: getAirportLounges
function.description: Retrieve a list of passenger lounges available at a specified terminal of Copenhagen Airport, including details such as access eligibility, operating hours, and available amenities.

terminal.description: Identifier of the terminal (e.g., A, B, C)

membershipLevel.description: Filter lounges by required membership level (e.g., Gold, Silver, None)

function.name: getCarRentalAvailability
function.description: Provides information about car rental companies operating at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, including available vehicle categories, real‑time fleet availability, and estimated pickup fees.

rentalCompany.description: Name of the car rental provider (e.g., Hertz, Avis). If omitted, information for all providers is returned.

vehicleType.description: Desired type of vehicle such as compact, SUV, or electric.

pickupDate.description: Date for which the rental availability is requested, in YYYY‑MM‑DD format.

function.name: getBikeShareStations
function.description: Provides a list of bike‑share docking stations near a specified location, including the number of available bicycles and empty docks, to help travelers plan short‑range transport around Copenhagen Airport.

location.description: The reference point (e.g., airport terminal, hotel name, or address) from which to search for bike‑share stations.

radius.description: Search radius around the location, expressed in meters (e.g., "500" for 500 m).

includeDetails.description: If set to "true", returns additional details such as station operating hours and nearby amenities.

function.name: getExchangeLiquidity
function.description: Retrieve liquidity information for a specific cryptocurrency on a given exchange, including order‑book depth, bid‑ask spread, and recent trading volume.

exchange.description: The name or identifier of the cryptocurrency exchange (e.g., 'Coinbase', 'Binance').

currency.description: The ticker symbol of the cryptocurrency (e.g., 'BTC', 'ETH').

function.name: getCryptoNewsSummary
function.description: Fetch a concise summary of the most recent news articles and headlines related to a given cryptocurrency.

currency.description: The ticker symbol or name of the cryptocurrency to retrieve news for.

timeWindow.description: The period to consider for news aggregation (e.g., "24h", "7d", "30d").

function.name: getHistoricalRegulatoryEvents
function.description: Provides a list of regulatory announcements, policy changes, or legal actions affecting a cryptocurrency within a specified date range and jurisdiction.

currency.description: The ticker symbol or identifier of the cryptocurrency.

startDate.description: The start date of the interval in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: The end date of the interval in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

region.description: Optional ISO country or region code to filter events by jurisdiction (e.g., US, EU).

function.name: getAccountLimits
function.description: Retrieve the spending, withdrawal, and deposit limits for a specific user account.

accountId.description: The unique identifier of the account.

limitCategory.description: Optional category of limits to fetch (e.g., 'withdrawal', 'deposit', 'trading').

function.name: getKYCVerificationStatus
function.description: Obtain the Know-Your-Customer verification status and pending document requirements for an account.

accountId.description: The unique identifier of the account.

includeDetails.description: If set to 'true', returns detailed information about missing documents.

function.name: listOpenOrders
function.description: Retrieve a list of all currently open (unfilled and uncancelled) orders for a Kraken account, with optional filtering by trading pair or order side.

pair.description: Optional trading pair to filter the results, e.g., 'ADAUSD'.

function.name: updateOrder
function.description: Modify parameters of an existing order on the Coinbase platform, such as amount or price, without creating a new order.

orderId.description: The unique identifier of the order to be updated.

newAmount.description: The new amount for the order, if it needs to be changed.

newPrice.description: The new price for the order, if it needs to be adjusted.

newType.description: The new order type (e.g., 'limit', 'market') if changing the type.

function.name: getStockFundamentals
function.description: Retrieves fundamental financial metrics for a specified publicly traded company, including market capitalization, price‑to‑earnings ratio, earnings per share, dividend yield, and other key ratios.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the company, e.g., AAPL

fields.description: Comma‑separated list of specific fundamental fields to return (e.g., marketCap, peRatio, eps). If omitted, a default set of fundamentals is provided.

function.name: getEarningsCalendar
function.description: Retrieve the upcoming earnings announcement dates and related details for a specified public company.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g., AAPL)

startDate.description: Earliest date to include in the calendar (ISO 8601 format)

endDate.description: Latest date to include in the calendar (ISO 8601 format)

function.name: getCryptoFundamentalScore
function.description: Calculate a composite fundamental score for a cryptocurrency based on factors such as developer activity, network usage, adoption metrics, and ecosystem health.

currency.description: Ticker symbol of the cryptocurrency, e.g., BTC

includeMetrics.description: Comma‑separated list of specific metrics to include, e.g., developerCount,activeAddresses

function.name: fetchForexNews
function.description: Retrieve recent news articles and headlines that affect foreign exchange markets for a given region or currency pair.

region.description: Geographic region or market focus, such as "Europe" or "Asia-Pacific".

sinceDate.description: ISO‑8601 date indicating the earliest news to include (optional).

currencyPair.description: Specific currency pair to filter news, formatted as "USD/EUR" (optional).

function.name: computeCorrelationMatrix
function.description: Calculates the correlation coefficients between multiple financial symbols over a specified time interval and returns a matrix indicating how each pair moves together.

symbols.description: List of ticker symbols to include in the correlation calculation.

interval.description: Time interval for the price data (e.g., 1min, 5min, daily).

startDate.description: Start date for the historical data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: End date for the historical data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: evaluatePortfolioRisk
function.description: Computes risk metrics such as Value at Risk (VaR) and Sharpe Ratio for a given portfolio based on historical price data and the selected confidence level.

weight.description: Proportion of the portfolio allocated to this asset (e.g., 0.25 for 25%).

portfolio.description: Array of portfolio holdings with their respective weights.

interval.description: Time interval for the price data used in calculations (e.g., daily, weekly).

confidenceLevel.description: Confidence level for VaR calculation expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.95 for 95%).

function.name: getRegulatoryInfo
function.description: Retrieve the regulatory status and compliance requirements of a specified cryptocurrency across different jurisdictions.

currency.description: The ticker symbol or name of the cryptocurrency (e.g., BTC, ETH).

jurisdiction.description: Optional ISO country code or region to limit the query to a specific jurisdiction.

function.name: getTokenSupplyInfo
function.description: Returns supply metrics for a cryptocurrency, including total supply, circulating supply, and maximum supply when applicable.

cryptocurrency.description: The ticker symbol or full name of the cryptocurrency to query.

includeBurned.description: Optional flag ('true' or 'false') indicating whether to include burned tokens in the total supply figure.

function.name: getDeveloperActivity
function.description: Retrieve development activity metrics for a cryptocurrency, such as number of commits, pull requests, and active contributors over a specified period.

currency.description: The ticker symbol of the cryptocurrency (e.g., BTC, ETH).

timeframe.description: Time period for which to aggregate activity, expressed as ISO 8601 duration (e.g., P30D for 30 days).

function.name: getRegulatoryNews
function.description: Fetch recent regulatory news articles, announcements, or official statements that pertain to a given cryptocurrency or jurisdiction, helping users stay informed about legal developments.

jurisdiction.description: The country or region whose regulatory actions are of interest (e.g., "USA", "EU", "Singapore").

currency.description: Optional cryptocurrency ticker to filter news specifically related to that asset.

days.description: Number of past days to search for news (e.g., "30" for the last 30 days).

function.name: calculateMiningProfitability
function.description: Estimates the daily profitability of mining a specific cryptocurrency based on the supplied hardware hash rate, power consumption, electricity cost, and optional pool fee.

currency.description: Cryptocurrency symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH).

powerConsumption.description: Power consumption of the mining hardware in watts.

electricityCost.description: Cost of electricity per kilowatt‑hour in USD.

poolFee.description: Mining pool fee as a percentage (optional).

function.name: getMiningPoolDetails
function.description: Provides detailed information about mining pools that support a given cryptocurrency, including pool fee, payout scheme, and server locations.

currency.description: Cryptocurrency symbol for which to retrieve pool information.

poolName.description: Specific mining pool name to query (optional).

function.name: getCryptoSupplyInfo
function.description: Retrieve supply details such as total, circulating, and max supply for a specified cryptocurrency.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol or identifier of the cryptocurrency (e.g., BTC, ETH).

includeBurned.description: Whether to include burned tokens in the total supply calculation (true or false).

function.name: getExchangeListingInfo
function.description: Provide a list of exchanges where the specified cryptocurrency is listed, including available trading pairs and basic exchange details.

currency.description: The ticker symbol or identifier of the cryptocurrency.

region.description: Optional region filter to limit exchanges to a specific geographic area.

function.name: getWhaleActivity
function.description: Retrieve details about large‑volume (whale) transactions for a specific cryptocurrency over a defined period, including total transferred amount and number of qualifying transfers.

currency.description: The ticker symbol of the cryptocurrency (e.g., BTC, ETH).

threshold.description: Minimum transaction size to be considered a whale transfer, expressed in the cryptocurrency's base units (e.g., "1000" for 1,000 BTC).

period.description: Time window for the query, such as "24h", "7d", or a specific ISO‑8601 date range.

function.name: archiveDocument
function.description: Archives the specified document to a designated storage location, optionally setting a retention period before permanent deletion.

documentId.description: The unique identifier of the document to be archived.

archiveLocation.description: The target archive storage location or bucket.

retentionDays.description: Number of days to retain the archived document before it may be purged.

function.name: convertDocumentFormat
function.description: Convert a document from its current file format to another specified format.

sourcePath.description: File system path to the source document.

destinationPath.description: Optional file system path where the converted document will be saved.

function.name: scheduleReminder
function.description: Schedule a reminder to be delivered to a recipient at a specified future time.

recipientEmail.description: Email address of the reminder recipient.

sendAt.description: ISO‑8601 timestamp indicating when the reminder should be sent.

function.name: logReminderActivity
function.description: Record the result and details of a reminder operation in an audit log for future reference.

reminderId.description: A unique identifier for the reminder instance.

status.description: The outcome status of the reminder (e.g., sent, failed, cancelled).

notes.description: Additional notes or context about the reminder operation.

function.name: listTemplates
function.description: Retrieve a paginated list of document templates available in the system, optionally filtered by keyword or category.

keyword.description: Search term to filter templates by name or description

category.description: Specific category or folder to limit the templates

pageSize.description: Maximum number of templates to return in one page

pageToken.description: Token indicating the page to retrieve for pagination

function.name: updateTemplateMetadata
function.description: Modify metadata of an existing document template, such as its name, description, or associated tags.

templateId.description: Unique identifier of the template to be updated.

tags.description: Comma‑separated list of tags to associate with the template.

function.name: extractDocumentMetadata
function.description: Extracts metadata information from a document, such as author, creation date, and custom tags.

function.name: getPublicHealthGuidelines
function.description: Provide the latest public health guidelines and recommendations for disease prevention and control in a specified region, covering topics like mask usage, social distancing, travel advisories, and vaccination policies.

region.description: Name or ISO code of the country or region for which guidelines are requested.

topic.description: Specific guideline area such as 'mask', 'travel', 'socialDistancing', or 'vaccination'. Optional.

function.name: getVaccinationCoverage
function.description: Retrieve vaccination coverage percentages for a specified vaccine across regions and demographic groups for a given year.

vaccineName.description: Name of the vaccine (e.g., measles, polio, COVID-19).

region.description: Geographical region or country for which coverage data is requested.

year.description: Calendar year of the coverage statistics.

function.name: getHospitalCapacityStats
function.description: Fetch hospital capacity statistics such as total beds, occupied beds, ICU beds, and ventilator usage for a specific region on a given date. Useful for assessing healthcare system load.

region.description: Geographic region or health authority identifier (e.g., state, province, health district).

date.description: Date for which the capacity data is requested, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY‑MM‑DD).

function.name: getHospitalBedUtilization
function.description: Provide current hospital resource usage for a given country or region, including total occupied beds, ICU occupancy, and available capacity for COVID‑19 patients.

region.description: Name or code of the country/region whose hospital bed data is required

date.description: Specific date for which the utilization data is requested, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY‑MM‑DD). If omitted, the latest available data is returned

function.name: getBikeSharingAvailability
function.description: Provide current bike and dock availability at bike‑sharing stations within a given radius of a location, enabling users to locate nearby stations with free bikes or empty docks.

location.description: Latitude and longitude of the reference point, formatted as 'lat,lon'.

radius.description: Search radius in meters around the location.

includeInactive.description: If true, also return stations that are currently inactive or out of service.

function.name: getParkingRates
function.description: Return the hourly and daily parking rates for public and private parking facilities near a specified location, optionally filtered by vehicle type.

location.description: Name or coordinates of the area for which parking rates are requested.

vehicleType.description: Type of vehicle (e.g., car, motorcycle, electric) to adjust price information if applicable.

date.description: Date for which rates apply, in ISO 8601 format, to account for special pricing days.

function.name: findChargingStations
function.description: Locate electric vehicle charging stations near a given point, providing details about connector types, power output, and current availability status.

location.description: Address, landmark, or coordinates where the search should be centered.

radius.description: Search radius in meters around the location.

connectorType.description: Desired connector standard (e.g., CCS, CHAdeMO, Type2).

function.name: getTrafficIncidents
function.description: Retrieve reported traffic incidents such as accidents, road closures, and hazards for a specified area and date range, including severity level and estimated delay time.

area.description: Geographic area (city, district, or coordinates) to search for incidents.

startDate.description: Start date for the incident search in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: End date for the incident search in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

incidentType.description: Optional filter for the type of incident (e.g., accident, closure, hazard).

function.name: getRoadworkSchedule
function.description: Provide information about upcoming road maintenance and construction projects within a given region and date, detailing affected lanes, expected duration, and potential traffic impact.

region.description: Name of the region or specific road segment to query for scheduled roadwork.

date.description: Date of interest in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) for which roadwork information is requested.

workType.description: Optional filter for the type of work (e.g., resurfacing, bridge repair, utility installation).

function.name: predictNamePopularityByYear
function.description: Predicts the historical popularity rank or count of a given first name for a specific calendar year using naming trend data.

year.description: The four‑digit year for which to retrieve popularity information (e.g., 1995).

function.name: suggestNamesForAgeGroup
function.description: Generates a list of common first names that are most frequently associated with individuals within a specified age range, with an optional country filter.

minAge.description: The lower bound of the age range (inclusive).

maxAge.description: The upper bound of the age range (inclusive).

country.description: Optional ISO country code to limit suggestions to that region.

function.name: computeKeywordFrequencyOverTime
function.description: Analyzes historical newspaper archives to compute how often a specific keyword appears over time within a given date range and geographic location, returning a time‑series of frequencies.

keyword.description: The word or phrase to count in newspaper content.

startDate.description: Earliest publication date (inclusive) in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: Latest publication date (inclusive) in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

location.description: U.S. state or city to limit the analysis.

granularity.description: Temporal granularity for the output series, e.g., "year" or "month".

function.name: translateHistoricalArticle
function.description: Translates the textual content of a specified historical newspaper page into a chosen modern language, optionally returning the original text alongside the translation.

pageId.description: Identifier of the newspaper page to translate.

targetLanguage.description: ISO 639‑1 code of the language to translate the text into.

includeOriginal.description: If true, the response includes both the original and translated texts.

function.name: generateNewspaperCitation
function.description: Create a properly formatted bibliographic citation for a historical American newspaper based on its title, publication date, and optional edition details.

date.description: Publication date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

edition.description: Edition or issue identifier, if applicable

citationStyle.description: Desired citation style (e.g., APA, MLA, Chicago)

function.name: fetchCirculationStatistics
function.description: Retrieve estimated circulation numbers and distribution regions for a given historical newspaper title and date range.

startDate.description: Start of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: End of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

region.description: Geographic region to filter circulation data (e.g., state or city)

function.name: analyzeArticleSentiment
function.description: Analyzes the tone of a news article's content retrieved from a URL and returns an overall sentiment classification (positive, negative, neutral) along with a confidence score.

url.description: The URL of the news article to evaluate.

language.description: ISO language code of the article text, if known (e.g., "en").

function.name: extractAdvertisements
function.description: Identifies and extracts advertisement segments from a given historical newspaper page, providing the ad text and optional bounding box coordinates for each ad region.

pageId.description: The unique identifier of the newspaper page containing advertisements.

includeBoundingBox.description: If true, returns the pixel coordinates of each advertisement region on the page image.

function.name: getWeatherByIp
function.description: Provides current weather conditions and a short forecast for the geographic location associated with an IP address.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to lookup.

date.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format for which to retrieve the forecast. Defaults to today.

function.name: getIspInfo
function.description: Returns information about the Internet Service Provider (ISP) serving the given IP address, including provider name and connection type.

includeSpeed.description: If set to 'true', includes the estimated connection speed category.

function.name: getISPDetails
function.description: Retrieves Internet Service Provider information for a given IP address, including the ISP name, organization, and autonomous system number (ASN).

ip.description: The IP address to look up.

includeAsn.description: If true, include the autonomous system number in the response.

function.name: getIPNetworkInfo
function.description: Provides network allocation details for an IP address, such as the CIDR block, network name, and the date the block was allocated.

ip.description: The IP address whose network information is requested.

includeAllocationDate.description: If true, include the allocation date of the network block.

function.name: getIspDetails
function.description: Fetches information about the internet service provider associated with a given IP address, including the provider name, organization, autonomous system number, and connection type.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to query.

include_asn.description: Whether to include Autonomous System Number details in the response.

function.name: getASNInfo
function.description: Retrieve the Autonomous System Number (ASN) and related organization information for a given IP address.

includeOrgName.description: Set to "true" to include the organization name associated with the ASN

function.name: checkIPBlacklist
function.description: Determine whether an IP address is listed on known spam or security blacklists and return the matching blacklist names.

blacklistProvider.description: Optional specific blacklist provider to query

function.name: getRegionalEconomicStats
function.description: Returns economic indicators such as GDP, median income, and unemployment rate for the region linked to a specific IP address.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address whose regional economic data is requested.

year.description: The calendar year for which the economic statistics should be reported (e.g., "2023").

indicators.description: A list of economic indicators to retrieve (e.g., ["gdp", "median_income", "unemployment_rate"]). If omitted, a default set of indicators is returned.

function.name: batchReverseGeocodeCoordinates
function.description: Convert an array of latitude and longitude pairs into their corresponding human‑readable addresses in a single request.

coordinates.description: List of coordinate objects, each containing 'latitude' and 'longitude' as numbers.

language.description: Preferred language for the returned address components (e.g., 'en', 'fr').

includePlaceIds.description: If true, include unique place identifiers in the response.

function.name: createGeofence
function.description: Define a geofence by specifying a central point and radius or a polygon of points, optionally assigning a name and notification settings.

center.description: Object with 'latitude' and 'longitude' for the geofence center.

radiusMeters.description: Radius of the circular geofence in meters. Ignored if 'polygon' is provided.

polygon.description: Array of coordinate objects defining the vertices of a polygonal geofence.

notifyOnEntry.description: Whether to trigger a notification when a device enters the geofence.

function.name: convertCoordinatesToUTM
function.description: Convert geographic latitude and longitude coordinates into the Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) coordinate system, returning the easting, northing and zone information.

hemisphere.description: Optional hemisphere indicator ('N' for northern, 'S' for southern).

function.name: getElevationByCoordinates
function.description: Retrieve the elevation (altitude) of a location based on its latitude and longitude coordinates.

units.description: Unit for elevation output, such as 'meters' or 'feet'. Default is meters.

function.name: reserveDomain
function.description: Reserve a custom branded domain for use with the URL shortening platform, preventing others from claiming it for a specified period.

domainName.description: The fully qualified domain name to reserve, e.g., brand.example.com

durationMonths.description: Number of months to hold the reservation for the domain

function.name: domainExpirationAlert
function.description: Monitor a custom domain's registration expiry date and schedule an alert to be sent a configurable number of days before the domain expires.

domainName.description: The domain whose expiration should be tracked

alertBeforeDays.description: How many days prior to expiration the alert should be triggered

function.name: getChapterDonations
function.description: Retrieve aggregated donation statistics for a specific Ducks Unlimited chapter, optionally filtered by fiscal year or donation type.

chapterId.description: The unique identifier of the Ducks Unlimited chapter.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year for which to retrieve donation totals, e.g., "2023".

donationType.description: Type of donation to filter by, such as "individual", "corporate", or "legacy".

function.name: getChapterVolunteerOpportunities
function.description: List current volunteer opportunities offered by a Ducks Unlimited chapter, with optional filters for activity type and date range.

chapterId.description: The unique identifier of the Ducks Unlimited chapter.

activityType.description: Filter opportunities by activity type, e.g., "habitat restoration", "education", "administrative".

startDate.description: Earliest start date (ISO 8601) for opportunities to include.

endDate.description: Latest end date (ISO 8601) for opportunities to include.

function.name: getChapterConservationProjects
function.description: Retrieve a list of conservation projects that a specific Ducks Unlimited chapter is involved in, with optional filters for the calendar year and the type of project (e.g., habitat restoration, water management).

chapterId.description: The unique identifier of the Ducks Unlimited chapter.

year.description: Four‑digit year to limit projects to a specific calendar year (e.g., "2023").

projectType.description: Category of conservation work, such as "habitatRestoration", "waterManagement", or "speciesProtection".

function.name: getChapterDonationSummary
function.description: Provide a financial summary of donations received by a Ducks Unlimited chapter, optionally broken down by a specific fiscal year.

chapterId.description: The unique identifier of the Ducks Unlimited chapter.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year for which to retrieve donation totals, formatted as "YYYY-YYYY" (e.g., "2022-2023").

function.name: recommendIngredientSubstitutes
function.description: Provides alternative ingredients for a specified food item, taking into account dietary preferences, allergies, cuisine style, and ingredient availability.

originalIngredient.description: The ingredient for which a substitute is needed.

targetDiet.description: Dietary preference or restriction (e.g., vegan, gluten‑free, low‑sodium).

cuisine.description: Preferred cuisine style to guide the substitution (e.g., Mediterranean, Asian).

function.name: estimateFoodCarbonFootprint
function.description: Provide an estimate of the greenhouse‑gas emissions (CO₂e) associated with producing a given food item or a list of items, optionally adjusted for serving size and region.

foodItem.description: Name of the food item to estimate carbon footprint for

servingSizeGrams.description: Weight of the serving in grams

region.description: Geographic region or country influencing production emissions

includeLifecycleStages.description: If true, break down emissions by farming, processing, transport, and retail stages

function.name: generateMealPlan
function.description: Creates a customized daily meal plan that meets a specified calorie target and macronutrient ratios, taking into account any dietary restrictions provided.

macroRatio.description: Desired macronutrient distribution expressed as a ratio, e.g., "50-30-20" for carbs-protein-fat percentages.

dietaryRestrictions.description: Comma‑separated list of restrictions such as "vegan, gluten‑free".

function.name: convertNutrientUnits
function.description: Convert a nutrient amount from one measurement unit to another (e.g., grams to milligrams, IU to micrograms). Handles common nutrition units and applies appropriate conversion factors.

fromUnit.description: Unit of the input value, such as 'g', 'mg', 'µg', 'IU'.

function.name: getRestaurantDetails
function.description: Retrieve comprehensive information about a restaurant, including its address, contact number, cuisine type, and optionally recent customer reviews.

includeReviews.description: Set to true to include the latest customer reviews in the response.

function.name: makeReservation
function.description: Create a reservation at a specific restaurant for a given date, time, and party size, optionally including special requests.

date.description: Reservation date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

partySize.description: Number of guests for the reservation.

specialRequests.description: Any additional notes or requests for the reservation.

function.name: generateRecoveryPlan
function.description: Create a personalized post‑exercise recovery plan including cooling‑down activities, hydration suggestions, and rest recommendations based on the performed activity and user‑reported soreness.

activityType.description: Type of physical activity performed, e.g., running, swimming, cycling.

durationMinutes.description: Length of the activity in minutes.

sorenessLevel.description: User‑reported muscle soreness on a scale such as none, mild, moderate, severe.

preferredRecoveryMethods.description: Comma‑separated list of recovery methods the user prefers, e.g., stretching, foam rolling, massage.

function.name: estimateHydrationRequirement
function.description: Calculates the recommended daily water intake for a user, taking into account the type and duration of physical activity, ambient temperature, and the user's body weight.

activity.description: Type of physical activity performed (e.g., running, hiking).

duration.description: Duration of the activity in minutes.

temperature.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Celsius during the activity.

function.name: setRateAlert
function.description: Registers an alert that triggers when the exchange rate of a specified currency against the Russian ruble moves above or below a given threshold, delivering a notification through the chosen channel.

currency.description: The three‑letter ISO code of the currency to monitor (e.g., USD, EUR).

threshold.description: The exchange rate value at which the alert should fire.

direction.description: Whether the alert should trigger when the rate goes "above" or "below" the threshold.

notificationMethod.description: Method to deliver the alert (e.g., email, sms, webhook).

notes.description: Optional free‑form note about the alert.

function.name: analyzeCurrencyVolatility
function.description: Calculates statistical volatility metrics for a given currency relative to the Russian ruble over a specified historical window, returning measures such as standard deviation, average daily change, or maximum drawdown.

currency.description: The three‑letter ISO code of the currency to analyze (e.g., GBP, JPY).

windowDays.description: Number of past days to include in the volatility analysis.

metric.description: The volatility metric to compute (e.g., "stdDev", "averageChange", "maxDrawdown").

includeChart.description: Whether to include a chart of the rate fluctuations in the response.

function.name: scheduleCurrencyConversion
function.description: Creates a scheduled conversion order to be executed on a future date, allowing users to lock in a target date for exchanging currencies.

amount.description: The amount of source currency to convert.

fromCurrency.description: ISO code of the currency to convert from.

toCurrency.description: ISO code of the currency to convert to.

executionDate.description: The ISO 8601 date and time when the conversion should be performed.

notificationEmail.description: Email address to notify when the scheduled conversion is executed.

function.name: analyzePatentCitations
function.description: Provide citation analysis for a European patent, including counts of cited and citing patents, citation depth, and optional network metrics.

patentId.description: The identifier of the European patent to analyze.

maxDepth.description: Maximum citation depth to explore in the citation graph.

includeMetrics.description: If true, return additional metrics such as citation centrality and trend scores.

function.name: estimatePatentValuation
function.description: Provides an estimated monetary value for a European patent based on market relevance, remaining term, citation strength, and comparable licensing data.

patent_id.description: The European patent identifier to evaluate.

time_horizon_years.description: Projection period in years over which the valuation is calculated.

function.name: translatePatentAbstract
function.description: Translates the abstract of a given European patent into a specified target language, preserving technical terminology and providing the result in plain text.

patent_id.description: The identifier of the European patent whose abstract should be translated.

target_language.description: ISO 639-1 language code representing the language to translate the abstract into (e.g., "en" for English, "de" for German).

function.name: convertPatentDocument
function.description: Convert a European patent document from one file format to another, such as PDF to XML or HTML, preserving all textual and figure content.

patentId.description: The identifier of the European patent or application to be converted.

sourceFormat.description: The current format of the document (e.g., pdf, xml, html).

targetFormat.description: The desired output format (e.g., xml, html, json).

function.name: linkBankAccount
function.description: Link an external bank account to a user's Kraken profile to enable deposits and withdrawals. The tool validates the provided banking details and associates the account with the specified customer.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer in the Kraken system

bank_name.description: Name of the bank where the external account is held

routing_number.description: Routing number or SWIFT code for the external bank

account_type.description: Type of the bank account, e.g., checking or savings (optional)

function.name: generateTaxReport
function.description: Produce a tax liability report for cryptocurrency transactions over a specified fiscal year, summarizing gains, losses, and required disclosures.

year.description: Fiscal year for which the tax report is generated.

format.description: File format of the generated report.

includeDetails.description: If true, include a line‑by‑line breakdown of each transaction.

function.name: exportQueryResults
function.description: Exports the results of a previously executed SQL query to a file in the specified format and location.

queryId.description: Identifier of the previously executed query whose results should be exported.

format.description: File format for the export, such as "csv", "json", or "xlsx".

destinationPath.description: Path or URI where the exported file will be stored.

function.name: manageQueryTemplate
function.description: Creates, updates, or deletes reusable SQL query templates for later execution.

templateName.description: Unique name for the query template.

queryText.description: SQL statement for the template; required for create and update actions.

description.description: Human‑readable description of what the template does.

function.name: validateModCompatibility
function.description: Evaluates a module against a specific game version and platform, reporting any compatibility issues or required adjustments.

mod_id.description: Identifier of the module to validate

gameVersion.description: Target game version for compatibility checking

platform.description: Target platform, such as PC, console, or mobile

function.name: exportModPackage
function.description: Generates a downloadable package of a specified module in a chosen archive format, optionally including its assets and documentation.

mod_id.description: Identifier of the module to export

format.description: Archive format for the package, e.g., zip or tar.gz

includeAssets.description: Whether to include the module's asset files

includeDocs.description: Whether to include documentation files with the package

function.name: fetchModMetrics
function.description: Retrieve various performance and popularity metrics for a specific mod, such as download count, average rating, and active user count.

mod_id.description: Unique identifier of the mod to query.

metrics.description: List of metric types to include in the response. If omitted, all available metrics are returned.

function.name: listModDependencies
function.description: List the required and optional dependencies for a given mod, including other mods, libraries, or game versions it relies on.

mod_id.description: Unique identifier of the mod whose dependencies are being queried.

includeOptional.description: If true, include optional dependencies in the result; otherwise only mandatory ones are returned.

function.name: archiveMod
function.description: Archive a specified mod for long‑term storage, moving it to an inactive archive state and recording the reason and retention period.

mod_id.description: The unique identifier of the mod to be archived.

reason.description: Explanation why the mod is being archived.

retention_days.description: Number of days the archived mod should be kept before permanent deletion.

function.name: modRatingSummary
function.description: Provides aggregated rating statistics for a specified mod, including average score, total number of ratings, and distribution across rating levels.

mod_id.description: Identifier of the mod to retrieve rating data for

include_comments.description: Whether to include recent user comments in the summary

function.name: checkModCompatibility
function.description: Evaluates whether a specific mod is compatible with a particular game version, returning compatibility status and any known issues.

mod_id.description: Identifier of the mod to be checked

target_version.description: The game version to test compatibility against

function.name: resetSteamPassword
function.description: Initiates a password reset process for a Steam account by sending a verification code to the registered email and allowing the user to set a new password.

username.description: The Steam account username for which to reset the password.

email.description: The email address associated with the Steam account to receive the verification code.

verificationCode.description: The code sent to the email to confirm the password reset request.

newPassword.description: The new password to set for the Steam account.

function.name: listGameDlcs
function.description: Retrieve a catalog of downloadable content (DLC) packages available for a given Steam game, including titles, release dates, and pricing information.

gameId.description: The unique identifier of the Steam game.

includeBeta.description: Set to 'true' to include beta or pre-release DLCs; otherwise omit or set to 'false'.

function.name: createTradeOffer
function.description: Create a Steam trade offer by specifying the offering user, the recipient user, and the items being offered and requested.

fromUserId.description: Steam ID of the user who initiates the trade

toUserId.description: Steam ID of the user who will receive the trade offer

offeredItemIds.description: Comma‑separated list of item IDs being offered

requestedItemIds.description: Comma‑separated list of item IDs being requested in return

function.name: fetchMarketPrice
function.description: Retrieves the current Steam Community Market price for a specific item within a game, optionally converting to a chosen currency.

gameId.description: Identifier of the Steam game containing the item.

itemId.description: Identifier of the item whose market price is requested.

currency.description: Three‑letter currency code (e.g., USD, EUR) for price conversion.

function.name: listUserFriends
function.description: Retrieve a Steam user's friends list, optionally filtered by online status.

userId.description: The Steam user identifier.

statusFilter.description: Optional filter for friend status (e.g., online, offline, away).

function.name: listSteamFriends
function.description: Retrieve a user's Steam friends list, including each friend's SteamID and current online status.

userId.description: Steam64 ID of the user whose friends are being queried

relationship.description: Optional filter for the type of relationship, such as 'friend' or 'blocked'

function.name: getFarewellMessage
function.description: Returns an appropriate farewell phrase (e.g., "Goodbye", "See you later") based on the specified language and optional time of day context.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for which the farewell should be generated

timeOfDay.description: Optional descriptor such as "morning", "evening", or "night" to tailor the farewell tone

function.name: getLanguageMetadata
function.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specified language code, such as the native name, script direction (ltr/rtl), and language family information.

languageCode.description: The ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-3 code of the language to look up (e.g., "en", "zh", "ar").

includeRegions.description: If true, also returns a list of regions where the language is commonly used.

function.name: getGreetingTone
function.description: Returns a greeting adjusted for a specified tone (e.g., formal, informal, friendly) in the requested language.

tone.description: The desired tone of the greeting, such as 'formal', 'informal', or 'friendly'.

language.description: ISO language code (e.g., 'en', 'es') for the greeting.

function.name: generateGreetingAudio
function.description: Creates an audio clip of a greeting in the chosen language and voice style, returning a URL to the generated file.

language.description: ISO language code for the greeting (e.g., 'en', 'fr').

voiceStyle.description: Preferred voice style such as 'male', 'female', or 'robotic'.

outputFormat.description: Audio file format to generate, e.g., 'mp3' or 'wav'.

function.name: fetchClinicalGuidelines
function.description: Retrieve the latest clinical practice guidelines for a specified medical condition and specialty, returning them in the requested format.

condition.description: The medical condition or disease for which guidelines are sought.

specialty.description: The clinical specialty (e.g., cardiology, neurology) relevant to the condition.

format.description: Desired output format such as plain text, JSON, or PDF.

function.name: detectAdverseDrugEvents
function.description: Analyze a list of administered medications together with reported patient symptoms to flag possible adverse drug events.

medicationList.description: Comma‑separated list of medications the patient is taking.

symptoms.description: Narrative description of the patient's current symptoms.

language.description: Language of the input text (default is English).

function.name: exportOntologySubset
function.description: Extracts a specific segment of a clinical ontology based on user‑defined filters such as hierarchy level, code prefix, or semantic group and returns the selected concepts in the requested file format (e.g., JSON, CSV, XML).

filterType.description: The category of filter to apply (e.g., level, prefix, group).

filterValue.description: The value corresponding to the chosen filter type.

outputFormat.description: Desired output format for the subset, such as json, csv, or xml.

function.name: mapClinicalCodes
function.description: Translates a list of local or proprietary clinical codes into equivalent standard ontology identifiers (e.g., SNOMED CT, ICD-10) using the integrated clinical ontology library.

localCodes.description: Array of local or custom clinical codes to be mapped.

targetOntology.description: The standard ontology to map to (e.g., "SNOMED", "ICD10").

function.name: deidentifyPatientRecords
function.description: Removes protected health information (PHI) such as names, dates, and identifiers from medical text, returning a de‑identified version suitable for sharing or analysis.

text.description: The raw medical text containing potential PHI.

redactionPolicy.description: Optional policy defining how identified PHI should be masked or replaced (e.g., replace with [REDACTED], hash, or remove).

function.name: mapClinicalTermsToCodes
function.description: Analyzes medical narrative text, identifies clinical concepts, and maps them to standardized terminology codes (e.g., SNOMED CT, ICD‑10) from the specified ontology.

text.description: Medical text containing clinical terms to be coded.

targetOntology.description: The standardized ontology to use for mapping (e.g., "SNOMED", "ICD10").

includeUnmapped.description: If set to "true", returns terms that could not be mapped in a separate list.

function.name: redactPersonalInfo
function.description: Detect and mask personally identifiable information such as names, addresses, and phone numbers in the input text, returning a redacted version.

text.description: The text containing potential personal information.

placeholder.description: String that will replace each detected piece of personal information.

function.name: configureTheme
function.description: Update the visual theme of the Metabase instance, including color palette, logo, and layout options.

themeName.description: Identifier of the theme to apply.

primaryColor.description: Hex code or CSS color for primary UI elements.

secondaryColor.description: Hex code or CSS color for secondary UI elements.

logoUrl.description: URL pointing to the logo image to display in the header.

function.name: scheduleReportDelivery
function.description: Create or modify a scheduled job that generates a Metabase report and emails it to specified recipients on a recurring basis.

reportId.description: Unique identifier of the Metabase report to be generated.

cronExpression.description: Cron expression defining the schedule (e.g., "0 8 * * MON").

recipients.description: List of email addresses that will receive the report.

enabled.description: Flag indicating whether the scheduled delivery is active.

function.name: archiveCollection
function.description: Moves a specified collection to an archive storage location and optionally sets a retention policy.

collectionId.description: The identifier of the collection to archive.

archivePath.description: File system or cloud path where the archived collection will be stored.

retentionDays.description: Number of days to keep the archived collection before automatic deletion.

function.name: exportCollection
function.description: Export the contents of a collection—including dashboards, issues, or code snippets—to a specified destination in a chosen format, optionally including metadata and version history.

collectionId.description: Identifier of the collection to be exported.
